There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.   • Support recruiting projects and process improvements as the team scales, including candidate experience and employer branding initiatives.

What you will need

  • 0–2 years of experience in recruiting, HR, operations, coordination, or related roles

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Comfort working with tools such as Google Sheets / Excel and basic ATS systems.

  • A proactive, learning-oriented mindset and openness to feedback.

  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and follow through reliably.

(Prior recruiting experience is helpful but not required. Attitude, curiosity, and execution matter more.)

Why join A1

  • Learn technical recruiting from the ground up in a small, high-bar team.

  • Work closely with experienced recruiters, engineers, and hiring managers.

  • Hands-on ownership and real responsibility from day one.

  • Flat structure where initiative and execution matter more than titles.

jobs.description:
Join the Tilt team

At Tilt, we see a side of people that traditional lenders miss. Our mobile-first products and machine learning-powered credit models look beyond credit scores, using over 250 real-time financial signals to recognize real potential. With millions of customers worldwide, we're not just changing how people access financial products — we're creating a new credit system that backs the working, whatever they're working toward.

The Opportunity: Senior Manager, Strategy & Business Operations

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Strategy & Business Operations to take on Tilt's highest-stakes, least-defined problems and drive them to outcomes. You'll sit at the center of our Strategy & BizOps team and move fluidly across corporate strategy, M&A, investor relations, and cross-market business operations — going wherever the company most needs a sharp operator to find the right answer and then make it happen.

This is a senior, high-autonomy role for someone who does their best work without a playbook. You'll frame ambiguous, board-level questions, build the analysis and the recommendation, bring executives and cross-functional teams along with you, and then own execution end-to-end, leveraging AI and automation along the way. You'll also serve as a credible, senior face for Tilt with external counterparties.

This is a remote role based in the US / Americas. Occasional travel is expected for company onsites and market visits (around 4 times per year).

If you're energized by owning critical problems from first principles to in-market results at a high-growth startup expanding access to fair cash and credit, this is the role for you.

How you'll make an impact

  • Lead critical strategy workstreams: Drive top-level "where to play / how to play" investment decisions, owning the modeling & strategic recommendations behind new product lines, licensing, and other structural bets.

  • Drive corporate development: Lead diligence on M&A opportunities and build proactive acquisition theses & target lists across Tilt’s markets. Own investor-relations strategy and execution.

  • Set the agenda on ambiguous problems: Take on cross-enterprise operational issues with no clear owner or precedent. Independently frame the problem, lay out and test hypotheses, build the analysis, and drive implementation of the best solutions.

  • Own high-impact business operation efforts: Lead initiatives within and across markets that build synergy and economies of scale across Tilt’s portfolio, from annual planning to executive reporting, reducing complexity and driving clearer ownership & visibility.

  • Support international expansion: Contribute to new-market selection, entry strategy, and resourcing decisions; from idea to launch execution.


Why you're a great fit

  • You have 5+ years of strategy, BizOps, corporate development, or other operating experience at high-growth startups. Prior top-tier management consulting experience is a plus.

  • You have a track record of owning ambiguous, high-stakes problems from definition through execution, and you move them forward independently.

  • You bring deep analytical and financial-modeling strength, using data to drive decisions and tell compelling stories.

  • You're highly organized and autonomous, comfortable owning ambiguous, high-impact work and building alignment across teams without heavy structure.

  • You're a clear, confident communicator who earns trust quickly with senior stakeholders.

  • You're a hands-on, results-focused operator, as comfortable in the weeds of a model as in front of the board.

  • You instinctively use AI & automation to turn manual work into repeatable systems.

  • You believe, like we do, that people are good for it — and that great products should reflect that trust.

Don’t meet every qualification? We care about potential over your past. If you're bringing ambition and drive to what we're building, we want to hear from you.

What you'll get at Tilt

  • Virtual-first teamwork: The Tilt team is collaborating across 14 countries, 12 time zones, and counting. You’ll get started with a WFH office reimbursement.

  • Competitive pay: We're big on potential, and it's reflected in our competitive compensation packages and generous equity.

  • Complete support: Find flexible health plans at every premium level, and substantial subsidies that stand up to global standards.

  • Visibility is yours: You can count on direct exposure to our leadership team — we’re a team where good ideas travel quickly.

  • Paid global onsites: Magic happens IRL: we gather twice yearly to reconnect over shared meals or kayaking adventures. (We’ve visited Vail, San Diego, and Mexico City, to name a few.)

  • Impact is recognized: Growth opportunities follow your contributions, not rigid promotion timelines.

The Tilt Way

We're looking for people who chase excellence and impact. Those who stand behind their work, celebrating the wins and learning from the missteps equally. We foster an environment where every voice is valued and mutual respect is non-negotiable — brilliant jerks need not apply. We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

You’re pushing ahead in your career? We can get behind that. Join us in building the credit system that people deserve.

Compensation Range: $180K - $210K

Job Title: Sr. Principal Engineer, Automation Engineering, Controls System Hardware -

Job Location: Lebanon, Indiana, United States of America

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.


The Senior Principal Engineer - Automation Engineering will work as a member of the Automation Engineering Department at Eli Lilly, Foundry. The principal engineer will provide automation support for one or more operating areas across site and/or for capital projects, with primary focus on Instrumentation and Control Hardware. Process Automation is core to delivering the right first-time facility start up and continued support of ongoing manufacturing operations into the future.

The Principal Engineer is also responsible for the productivity and mentorship of the other Engineers in the team with the purpose of ensuring that reliable and compliant control applications and systems are used in the manufacturing at Foundry. Additionally, the Principal Engineer, as a key technical expert will collaborate with partners within the process control organization and across functional disciplines to support the process control technical agenda, business plan priorities, and compliance objectives.

In the project delivery phase and startup phase of the project (startup expected 2026 to 2028), automation engineering roles will be fluid and dynamic as we endeavor to support the project delivery, build a new organization, develop and implement the necessary systems and business processes required to support GMP operations, and build the site culture. This will require significant collaboration, creativity and resilience as the site grows to a full scale GMP manufacturing through start up.

Key Objectives/Deliverables:

  • Lead site operation support, capital project execution and commissioning & qualification.
  • Demonstrated ability in translating technical concepts for executive audience and/or non-technical stakeholders.
  • Deep Expertise working with DeltaV Distributed Control System, Batch Process Automation.
  • Deep Expertise working with Rockwell Allen Bradley PLC’s, FactoryTalk View.
  • Expertise working with DeltaV control panels, DeltaV Remote I/O panels and Rockwell I/O’s.
  • Expertise in performing automation engineering activities including design, Development and Commissioning Process Automation projects using DeltaV DCS, tuning and troubleshooting of control loops.
  • Thorough understanding of various process control communication protocols.
  • Develop and implement the Automation Engineering Project Plan.
  • Define strategies for periodic and corrective maintenance of Instruments and Control hardware.

Operational Excellence

  • System level thinking and expertise working with multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Technical Leadership in leading projects from concept through Commissioning and Qualification.
  • Demonstrated ability in resolving complex technical challenges with instrument and control system hardware.
  • Technically lead and oversee the work of Site Area leads and System Integrators.
  • Develop and Review Functional Requirements, Design Specifications and Test Specifications.
  • Thorough understanding of 21CFR Part 11, GMP processes.
  • Demonstrated experience with developing and utilizing Master maintenance plans.
  • Lead/Participate in design reviews and Site system hardware reviews, attend equipment and FATs.
  • Provide periodic status updates to Leadership and Project Management.
  • Implement and support electronic systems (such as plant historians) used to capture process automation related production data.
  • Maintain the validated state of the site control system hardware in line with Lilly quality standards including the development and execution of validation strategies and associated documentation.
  • Promote the use of automation to improve productivity, operational efficiency and compliance.
  • Develop a ‘network’ of corporate contacts and leverage corporate expertise when needed.
  • Experience in clinical-stage manufacturing with flexible, multi-product capabilities is preferred.

Organizational Capability

  • In coordination with automation and compliance consultants, set and reinforce standards for appropriate rigor in automation work products.
  • Mentor process control team to strengthen technical capabilities and adopt best practices to enhance system reliability and business continuity.
  • Be a fully active member of the flow leadership in running the plant, including participation on technical sub-teams.

Basic Requirements:

  • Minimum B.S. in Engineering or related field and experience in Automation Engineering
  • 8+ years working experience in Pharmaceutical or highly regulated environment
  • Experience working in highly automated facility, using DeltaV DCS, Rockwell Allen Bradley PLC, Veeva, PI, and/or BMS Warehouse Monitoring from design through Startup.
  • Knowledge of GMP, regulatory requirements, computer system validation
  • Available to participate in a rotational on-call schedule
  • Qualified applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. Lilly will not provide support for or sponsor work authorization or visas for this role, including but not limited to F-1 CPT, F-1 OPT, F-1 STEM OPT, J-1, H-1B, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, or L-1.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Demonstrated initiative, good planning and organizational skills, ability to prioritize tasks, commitment to task completion and timelines.
  • Hands-on experience working directly with automation control panel hardware and wiring.
  • Possess a keen technical curiosity and has demonstrated strong problem-solving skills and a desire for continuous improvement
  • Demonstrated ability to influence peers and business partners, influence without authority.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences

Lilly is dedicated to helping individuals with disabilities to actively engage in the workforce, ensuring equal opportunities when vying for positions. If you require accommodation to submit a resume for a position at Lilly, please complete the accommodation request form () for further assistance. Please note this is for individuals to request an accommodation as part of the application process and any other correspondence will not receive a response.

Our employee resource groups (ERGs) offer strong support networks for their members and are open to all employees. Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT:

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for:

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard:
Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

Requirements and benefits

Educational qualifications

  • A Master’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science / Data Analytics, Artificial Intelligence / Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics / Natural Language Processing (NLP), Information Systems or other related fields.
  • Bachelor’s degree is accepted if only candidate has 5 years of experience in the field.

Academic and/or Professional Experience

Candidates should have a minimum of 3 years of professional experience in related roles or domain - specifically for QA-automation/testing or cybersecurity roles

How it works
Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation:
Paid per accepted task. Your rate depends on the qualification tier you reach and how efficiently you complete tasks — up to the equivalent of $50/hr. Because payment is per task, a faster pace raises your effective hourly rate.

Patients with a history of bone marrow or solid organ transplant can suffer from this rare, often deadly lymphoma. This is an opportunity for “builders” those who are looking to contribute to the creation of a new US organization, with a potentially transformative therapy, and we are looking for candidates that have a growth mindset and thrive in a start-up environment that will be scaling up the Pierre Fabre presence in the US pharmaceuticals market. In the preapproval phase, the CTAD will be responsible for leading disease awareness efforts, developing relationships with both the clinical and non-clinical experts to understand unmet need and patient journey, as well as leading the onboarding process for launching an allogeneic cell therapy. Post-approval, the CTADs will be responsible for appropriately driving demand and working cross functionally to support utilization and treatment experience of Tab-cel within institutions in their assigned territory.

  • At least 10 years of experience within the biopharma industry

  • Demonstrated experience in participating in a collaborative and complex matrix environment

  • A passion for making a difference in the lives of patients

PREFERRED EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience managing large geographies

Job Description:

Seize your opportunity to make a personal impact supporting the Case Management Modernization (CMM) Program. The CMM program is an initiative to support the Administrative Office of the US Courts (AO) in developing a modern cloud-based solution to support all 204+ federal courts across the United States.

GDIT is your place to make meaningful contributions to challenging projects and grow a rewarding career. The Metadata & Data Catalog Specialist will be part of the CMM Data Modernization and Governance team responsible for delivering an integrated data governance, engineering, data platform, reporting, analytics, and Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities that support operational decision-making and fulfill AO's data and analytics objectives in support of the CMM program.

The successful candidate will be responsible for implementing and operating CMM's metadata management, business glossary, data catalog, and data lineage capabilities to accelerate CMM modernization efforts. The role establishes consistent metadata practices, enables discovery and understanding of enterprise data assets, and configures and manages governance platforms, catalogs, metadata repositories, and related tooling that make enterprise data discoverable, well-defined, and traceable, enabling effective governance, data quality, and self-service data use across the organization.

The Metadata & Data Catalog Specialist will execute the following responsibilities:

  • Implement and maintain metadata management, business glossary, data catalog, and data lineage capabilities.
  • Configure, administer, and maintain data governance, catalog, metadata, and lineage platforms.
  • Establish metadata standards, structures, naming conventions, and management practices.
  • Develop and maintain the enterprise and domain-level business glossary.
  • Capture and maintain business, technical, operational, and governance metadata.
  • Establish relationships between data assets, business terms, data elements, systems, applications, reports, and data products.
  • Implement and maintain end-to-end data lineage across critical data assets and data flows.
  • Integrate metadata from source systems, databases, data warehouses, data lakes, APIs, ETL/ELT pipelines, BI platforms, and other data environments.
  • Configure metadata ingestion, scanning, classification, tagging, and discovery capabilities.
  • Support automated metadata harvesting and synchronization where appropriate.
  • Implement data ownership, stewardship, certification, and approval workflows within governance platforms.
  • Support onboarding new data sources and systems into the data catalog, including configuration of automated metadata harvesting and scanning.
  • Configure integrations between the data catalog/metadata platform and other governance, data quality, and IT systems.
  • Ensure metadata accurately reflects data definitions, classifications, ownership, sensitivity, retention, and other governance attributes.
  • Partner with Data Governance Analysts, Data Quality Analysts, Data Architects, Data Stewards, and business stakeholders to maintain trusted metadata.
  • Support data discovery and self-service data access for authorized users.
  • Develop dashboards and reports measuring catalog adoption, metadata completeness, stewardship, lineage coverage, and governance maturity.
  • Monitor metadata quality and identify gaps, inconsistencies, and stale metadata.
  • Support integration between catalog, governance, data quality, security, privacy, and enterprise architecture capabilities.
  • Develop documentation, procedures, and operating standards for metadata and catalog management.
  • Provide training and support to Data Stewards and business users on catalog and metadata capabilities.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve metadata management and data discovery capabilities.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • MA/MS degree with 5+ years of general experience in information systems and 7+ years of specialized experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in supporting enterprise data governance programs.
  • Experience translating governance policy into practical operational processes in delivery environments.
  • Experience governing high-sensitivity or regulated data with clear compliance expectations.
  • Experience with access management and operationalizing privacy requirements.
  • Experience partnering with security, governance, and engineering teams to implement compliant data sharing.
  • Strong process mapping, documentation, and business analysis skills.
  • Excellent facilitation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to translate policy and governance requirements into clear, actionable operational procedures.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including development of training and change management materials.
  • Analytical mindset with strong problem-solving and organizational skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in Federal Government or regulated environments.
  • Experience with enterprise data governance/catalog platforms.
  • Experience with enterprise data governance frameworks and operating models.
  • Data management certification.

jobs.description:
JUNIOR FULL STACK ENGINEER – AI

The Role

You will join a company building the digital infrastructure for grant funding, helping organizations spend less time navigating funding logic, forms, and administration and more time on the projects and impact that matter.

The platform brings together research across 18,000+ funding programmes, AI-supported analysis and application drafting, expert review, and ongoing grant management. AI handles what can scale, while people bring experience and judgement where it matters.

As a Junior Full Stack Engineer, you will help build the product across the backend, frontend, and AI pipeline at the core of the platform. You will work directly with the CTO, who already has one successful exit, and learn first-hand how modern software is built in a clean, fast, AI-native environment.

This role is designed for someone early in their career who wants real responsibility and a steep learning curve. You will start with close guidance and progressively take on more independent ownership, with a clear path toward a senior engineering role.

Position: Junior Full Stack Engineer – AI

Seeking an early-career Software Engineer with solid programming fundamentals, curiosity across the stack, and a strong desire to learn how production software is built.

The ideal candidate has 1–3 years of experience or is a recent graduate with strong projects, and is hungry to learn, ambitious, driven, curious, and highly coachable.

You should be excited to work closely with the CTO, ask questions, take initiative, and progressively take on more responsibility as you grow.

You don't need to know everything. What matters is having the mindset of: “I don't know this yet, but I want to figure it out.”

We care more about what you've built and how you think than a perfect CV. Personal projects, university projects, internships, and side projects all count.

Responsibilities


Product Development & Full-Stack Engineering

  • Ship features end-to-end, from backend development through to the user interface.

  • Work across the stack, including React, Node/Express, Postgres, and AWS.

  • Start with close guidance and progressively take on greater independence and ownership.

  • Work closely with the CTO and grant team to build solutions based on real user problems rather than abstract tickets.

  • Build software with a user-first mindset, ensuring what you create works for real people.


AI Development

  • Help build the platform's AI pipeline from week one.

  • Work with prompt engineering, context management, and AI evaluations.

  • Gain hands-on experience with AI development and learn how AI-powered features are built and improved in production.

  • Use AI-native development tools such as Claude Code or Cursor as part of your engineering workflow.


Production & Debugging

  • Trace and fix bugs in the production environment.

  • Work with tools including Sentry, CloudWatch, and Postgres.

  • Learn how production systems work by investigating real issues and understanding their underlying causes.

  • Develop strong debugging and problem-solving skills through hands-on production experience.


Learning & Engineering Growth

  • Work closely with the CTO and receive direct technical mentoring.

  • Use code reviews as a learning tool, incorporating feedback and progressively contributing feedback to others.

  • Take increasing ownership of features and technical problems as your experience grows.

  • Develop toward independent feature ownership, with a clear path toward a senior engineering role.

  • Contribute to improving the time from starting a project to a finished, submitted application through reliable features, automation, and product improvements.

Requirements

  • 1–3 years of professional experience as a Software Engineer, or recent university graduation with strong technical projects.

  • What you have built matters more than simply the number of years of experience.

  • Solid fundamentals in TypeScript and/or JavaScript.

  • Curiosity and willingness to work across the full stack, including:

    • React

    • Node / Express

    • Postgres

    • AWS

  • Strong desire to learn how production software is built and operated.

  • High self-motivation and the ability to dig into problems rather than wait for instructions.

  • Comfortable receiving feedback and using it to improve your technical skills.

  • AI-native approach to software development, with familiarity using tools such as Claude Code or Cursor.

  • User-first mindset, with a focus on building software that works for real people.

  • Strong curiosity, ownership, and willingness to take on increasing responsibility.

Nice to Have

  • First experience with AI tools or LLM APIs, including university or side projects.

  • German language skills at B1 level or above. The product and customers are German-speaking, while the team works bilingually.

  • A side project, open-source contribution, or other work built independently.

Growth Path

This role is designed as a springboard for your engineering career.

You’ll start with significant mentoring and guidance from the CTO, then progressively move toward independent ownership of complete features and technical problems.

The goal is to help you grow into an engineer who can ship independently, contribute to technical decisions, and take ownership of increasingly complex parts of the product, with a clear path toward a senior engineering role.

What We Offer

  • Direct mentoring from the CTO, who already has one successful exit and will work closely with you on your development.

  • A steep learning curve across a modern technology stack, AI-native development, and real production systems.

  • Real production ownership from day one, with increasing responsibility over time.

  • Fully remote work is possible.

  • Competitive entry-level salary and participation in company success.

  • Clear development path toward a senior engineering role.

  • €2,000 annual professional development budget.

  • Opportunity to work on a scalable SaaS product with clear market demand and genuine social impact.

  • Short decision paths and direct collaboration with the leadership team.

  • Team events and optional workations.

Our Culture

Customer First · Complete Ownership · Ship, Learn, Repeat · One Team

About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our product focuses on achieving high reliability for long-running workflows, persistent context, and real-world task completion. We believe products will greatly reduce hallucinations.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things.

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

jobs.title: Chaplain Part Time Bethany, MO
jobs.excerpt: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Please Note: While assigned hours are generally consistent from week to week, there are no guaranteed minimal hours and positional needs will vary depending on Chaplain availability and Client requirements.

This role is Part-Time in Bethany, MO. (1-4 hrs per week)

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.

Ministry

  • Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.
  • Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.
  • May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.
  • May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.
  • May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.
  • Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.
  • May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.
  • May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.
  • Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.
  • Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).
  • Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.
  • With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.

Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

8. Must have active state driver’s license and state minimum auto insurance (state(s) where servicing clients).

Conditions of Employment
Must pass a pre-employment background check.

Work Environment
This is a remote position in the field, and the work environment is dependent upon the clients’ worksite. Work environments can include manufacturing, hospitals, office buildings, and funeral homes with differing levels of temperature, noise, and light exposure.

Contexte de la mission

We are seeking an experienced SAP Functional Consultant to join our project team to work for one of our customers in an international context. The successful candidate will play a key role in the implementation of MS Fabric Reporting mainly based on an S/4HANA Greenfield environment, working closely with business stakeholders and technical teams. The primary responsibility will be to gather requirements, analyze, and document functional specifications based on workshop inputs from business users, with a main focus on S/4HANA, SAP BW and other satellite systems of S/4. The role involves collaborating with various business teams (S2P, L2C, P2P, Sustainability, etc.) to define the functional reporting requirements based on business inputs.

  • Tâches à réaliser :
    • Facilitate and lead functional workshops with business teams.
    • Translate business needs into detailed functional specifications for MS Fabric data integration and datamodeling.
    • Collaborate with technical teams to ensure alignment between functional and technical designs.
    • Provide documentation following project standards and best practices.
    • Act as a link between business users and technical teams, ensuring clear communication and understanding.

Compétences recherchées

Expérience nécessaire :At least 5 years of experience in SAP functional processes and integration projects.

Methodology : Waterfall

Languages : English (Fluent)

Obligatoires :

  • Proven experience as an SAP Functional Expert on different modules, preferably in similar integration and data projects.
    • Strong understanding of business processes across SAP modules such as Finance, Procurement, Sales, Inventory, etc.
    • Ability to facilitate workshops and coordinate efforts across multiple business units.
    • Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
    • Analytical mindset, strictness, proactive approach, and autonomy.
  • Optionnelles :
    • Knowledge in datamodeling (MS Fabric or BI reporting tools) is a plus.

All our positions are open to both women and men and are, of course, open to people with disabilities.

jobs.excerpt: Ready to be a Titan? Most compensation functions answer questions.
jobs.description:
Ready to be a Titan?

Most compensation functions answer questions. We're building one that anticipates them.

ServiceTitan is a post-IPO, globally distributed software company with operations across the US, Canada, Armenia, India, Poland, and Australia. Our compensation function owns the full stack — strategy, structure, incentive design, equity programs, cycle execution, enablement and the employee and manager experience of all of it. What's unusual is what we're building toward: instant, dynamic visibility for every employee into their total compensation, tools to model equity outcomes, and managers who understand their budget and feel confident having comp conversations before they need to.

In this role you’ll lead the modeling, tools and enablement that turn our compensation approach into a strategic asset, thinking about all of it the way a product manager thinks about a product: who's the user, what's creating friction, and what does a better version look like?

You're energized by the intersection of innovative plan design, financial rigor and employee experience. You build trust with collaborators by partnering with them to prioritize and solve for the most pressing business problems and opportunities. You have ideas on how to leverage technology, automation and AI to model innovative incentive and equity plan design structures, create budgets that both make sense for business needs and meet the guardrails that will keep ServiceTitan successful, and lead our global compensation frameworks.

What You'll Do:

  • Lead the design and evolution of our bonus and long-term incentive programs, connecting individual and company performance to outcomes that are understandable, motivating, and aligned with how the business creates value.
  • Own equity design as a strategic asset — design equity programs to attract and retain top talent, and drive performance differentiation, build the enablement that drives understanding, and partner with Finance and Legal on program mechanics, dilution modeling, and board approval.
  • Own the tools and access that our talent acquisition team needs to drive the most competitive offers, that the BP teams need to partner with their business leaders, and that leaders, managers and employees need to truly understand compensation rhythms, cadences and budgets at any time throughout the year.
  • Own the architecture that enables the compensation team to move quickly, and enable partner teams requiring compensation inputs at offer, internal moves or new roles
  • Partner with talent management on pay for performance alignment, ensuring that we are enabling leaders, managers and employees to fully understand their compensation outcomes
  • Stay ahead of the market through real-time data and peer relationships, monitoring how AI, pay transparency legislation, and workforce shifts are changing the landscape before they show up in offers or attrition.

What You'll Bring:

  • 7+ years of relevant experience designing & building global compensation structures across various markets (North America, EMEA, etc)
  • Experience or exposure to high growth business
  • Knowledge of a broad set of tools and technology that make the work efficient and delivery optimal outcomes
  • Ability to juggle strategic projects and tactical day-to-day tasks
  • Complex problem solving skills
  • Attention to detail
  • Expert modelling capabilities
  • Excellent communication skills, with high attention to detail. Comfortable navigating leadership across all levels (Including Board level)
  • Ability to prioritize tasks, learn quickly and work independently
  • Experience collaborating with internal stakeholders at all levels
  • Experience building, designing and managing global compensation & equity programs
  • Demonstrated ability to think creatively, strategically, and operationally with strong analytical skills

Be Human With Us:

Being human isn’t about checking every box on a list. It’s about the experiences we have, people we meet, and the perspectives we share. So, if you have the skills but are hesitant to apply because of your background, apply anyway. We need amazing people like you to help us challenge the conventional and think differently about the problems that we’re solving. We’re in this together. Come be human, with us.

What We Offer:

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

  • Flextime, recognition, and support for autonomous work: Flexible time off with ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career. We offer a comprehensive onboarding program, leadership training for Titans at all levels, and other programs and events. Great work is rewarded through Bonusly, peer-nominated awards, and more.

  • Holistic health and wellness benefits: Company-paid medical, dental, and vision for you and your dependents, RSP match, and an employee assistance program.

  • Support for Titans at all stages of life: Parental leave and support, up to $20k in adoption reimbursement, on demand maternity support through Maven Maternity, free breast milk shipping through Maven Milk, financial planning tools, and more.

Our Commitment to Inclusion:

At ServiceTitan, we celebrate individuality and uniqueness. We believe that the convergence of fresh perspectives and experiences from all walks of life is what makes our product and culture so great. We strongly encourage people from underrepresented groups to apply. ServiceTitan is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against employees based on race, colour, religion, creed, sex, national origin, gender identity or expression, age, disability, pregnancy (including childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical condition), marital status, family status, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable provincial legislation.

jobs.description:
The Product Owner translates product strategy and roadmap priorities into clear, actionable work for development teams, and drives the value delivered by every release and sprint. This is a tactical, execution-focused role: the Product Owner owns the backlog for a defined product area, works day-to-day with development and design, and ensures that what gets built matches what customers and the business need most.

Acting as the primary connection point between the Product Manager's vision and the development team's execution, the Product Owner combines strong product domain knowledge with hands-on agile delivery experience. Success in this role depends on sound day-to-day judgment — making trade-off decisions that keep delivery aligned to the broader product strategy set by Product Management and business leaders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and prioritize the product backlog for an assigned product area, writing clear user stories and acceptance criteria that translate roadmap themes and customer requirements into actionable development work.
  • Partner daily with developers and designers throughout the development lifecycle — refinement, sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives — making timely trade-off decisions on scope, sequencing, and priority, and escalating strategic or financial trade-offs to the Product Manager or Director as needed.
  • Validate that delivered features meet acceptance criteria and the intended customer or business outcome, serving as the day-to-day point of contact for development on requirements, intent, and priority.
  • Gather and synthesize input from Sales, Customer Success, Support, and customers to inform backlog refinement, and support the Product Manager with market research, competitive analysis, and feature-level requirements.
  • Track and report on sprint and release progress, velocity, and delivery metrics, proactively flagging risks to scope or timeline, and incorporate feedback from user acceptance testing and beta programs into subsequent backlog iterations.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, business, technology, or equivalent experience.

  • 2-4 years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or in a related agile delivery/product role at a software company.

  • Working knowledge of agile/scrum methodologies and hands-on experience with backlog and sprint management tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps.

jobs.description:
职位概况

我们正在寻找一位位于佛山或周边地区的兼职合同制家具采购与物流代理，协助一个定制住宅项目完成家具、家居材料及相关物流的实地采购工作。你将根据设计师和业主家庭的需求，走访佛山及周边家具市场、展厅、工厂、仓库和供应商，收集报价、照片、视频和规格信息，并协助推进下单、付款、验货、包装、运输和交付安排。

工作内容

  • 走访佛山及周边城市的家具市场、展厅、工厂、仓库和供应商。

  • 根据设计需求、预算、尺寸、材质和时间要求寻找合适家具选项。

  • 拍摄清晰照片和视频，收集报价，确认规格，并整理选项供业主审核。

  • 在合适情况下协助谈价和确认条款，帮助筛选可靠供应商。

  • 协调下单、付款、验货、包装、本地运输、出口或国内物流以及交付时间。

  • 用英文和中文与业主家庭、设计师、供应商和物流方清晰沟通。

  • 用简单共享表格或文档跟踪价格、联系人、决策和下一步事项。

任职要求

  • 常驻佛山，或能够经常前往佛山家具市场和供应商处。

  • 中文沟通能力强；具备用于更新、总结和电话沟通的英文能力。

  • 有家具采购、室内设计采购、出口物流、买手或采购代理等实地采购经验。

  • 对质量、材质、饰面、尺寸和实际交付细节有判断力。

  • 能够独立走访供应商，快速推进，并提供有条理的更新。

  • 做事可靠透明，能谨慎处理报价、付款、时间线和供应商沟通。

加分项

  • 在佛山、乐从、顺德或周边家具产业带有现成供应商资源。

  • 有定制家具、住宅装修项目或国际运输经验。

  • 能够检查样品、饰面、软包、木材、石材、金属、灯具或相关家居材料。

申请问题

  • 请简要说明你与家具采购、供应商协调或物流相关的经验。

  • 请说明你通常能前往佛山家具市场或供应商处的频率。

  • 如有相关项目照片、供应商案例、采购表格或作品集，请附上链接。

Role Overview

We are looking for a part-time contract furniture sourcing and logistics agent based in Foshan or nearby. This is a one-time project for a custom family home after the design is complete. You will help source furniture and related home materials, visit suppliers in person, collect quotes and specifications, and coordinate the practical details from selection through ordering, inspection, packing, transport, and delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Visit furniture markets, showrooms, factories, warehouses, and suppliers in Foshan and nearby cities.

  • Source furniture options that match the design brief, budget, dimensions, materials, and timing.

  • Take clear photos and videos, collect quotes, confirm specifications, and organize options for review.

  • Negotiate pricing and terms when appropriate, and help identify reliable suppliers.

  • Coordinate ordering, payments, inspections, packing, local transport, export or domestic logistics, and delivery timing.

  • Communicate clearly in English and Chinese with the family, designers, vendors, and logistics providers.

  • Track details in a simple shared spreadsheet or document so decisions, prices, contacts, and next steps stay organized.

Requirements

  • Based in Foshan or able to travel frequently to Foshan furniture markets and suppliers.

  • Strong spoken and written Chinese; working English for updates, summaries, and calls.

  • Experience in furniture sourcing, interior design procurement, export logistics, buying agency work, or similar hands-on sourcing work.

  • Good eye for quality, materials, finishes, dimensions, and practical delivery details.

  • Comfortable moving quickly, visiting suppliers independently, and sending organized updates.

  • Reliable, transparent, and careful with pricing, payments, timelines, and vendor communication.

Helpful but not required

  • Existing supplier contacts in Foshan, Lecong, Shunde, or nearby furniture hubs.

  • Experience with custom furniture, home renovation projects, or international shipping.

  • Ability to inspect samples, finishes, upholstery, wood, stone, metalwork, lighting, or related home materials.

Application questions

  • Please apply with a short note about your relevant sourcing, furniture, supplier coordination, or logistics experience.

  • Please mention how often you can visit Foshan furniture markets or suppliers.

  • If available, include links to relevant project photos, supplier examples, procurement sheets, or portfolio materials.

Description

🤓 TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We're looking for the person who brings a Forward Deployed Engineering curriculum to life for students: you would be part of a team of senior authors who help create the content for the course. The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. They've shipped real software for years and are moving deliberately into forward-deployed AI work; some are already interviewing for FDE roles while they study. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

Format: asynchronous, estimated 20 hrs/week.

Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

What you will do

  • Design and build the projects students work on end to end — scope, learning goals, technical infrastructure, environments, and supporting databases or datasets.
  • Write clear submission guidelines and assessment criteria (rubrics) that reviewers can apply consistently.
  • Work closely with Learning Experience Designers to make projects and lessons educationally sound and engaging: refining wording, pacing, and difficulty calibration across the course.
  • Research, evaluate, and sign off on technical solutions and tooling so the curriculum stays current and relevant to what employers actually use.
  • Contribute to sales and marketing enablement — training commercial teams on what the course covers and what graduates can do.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional engineering experience, currently working at senior level or above (Senior/Lead/Staff Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Solutions Architect, or technical lead on customer-facing delivery).
  • Has personally owned deployments end-to-end in real client or enterprise environments – first call through production go-live and adoption.
  • Practical experience with databases and the infrastructure needed to run student projects (cloud environments, containers, version control, CI where relevant).
  • Ability to break complex technical work into scoped, assessable tasks at a defined difficulty level.
  • Strong written communication in English — you'll produce a lot of instructional text and it needs to be unambiguous.
  • Comfort collaborating cross-functionally with instructional design, and explaining technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience mentoring, teaching, tutoring, or reviewing others' code.

Preferred experience:

  • Prior EdTech or rubric/assessment design experience.

What we can offer you

  • Fully remote work.
  • A digital office: we use modern tools (Notion, Slack, Zoom) to keep collaboration smooth.
  • Professional trust and autonomy: no micromanaging.
  • A diverse, international, close-knit team excited to work with you!

We're looking for a confident communicator to join our sales team. In this role, you'll introduce our services to marketing executives across the United States, identify potential opportunities, and schedule qualified meetings for our sales team.
Previous cold-calling or B2B sales experience is helpful but not essential. We welcome applications from recent graduates, career changers, and motivated individuals with excellent communication skills.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prospect. Make outbound cold calls to marketing executives and business decision-makers across the United States.
  • Engage. Speak with decision-makers such as Marketing Directors, Marketing Managers, Chief Marketing Officers (CMOs), Digital Marketing Managers, Growth Marketing Managers, Brand Managers, and business owners.
  • Present. Introduce our services in a clear, professional, and conversational manner.
  • Qualify. Build rapport, ask thoughtful qualifying questions, and identify prospective clients who are a good fit for our services.
  • Handle objections. Respond professionally to common questions and objections while maintaining a positive customer experience.
  • Book meetings. Schedule qualified appointments for our sales team and ensure accurate calendar coordination.
  • Maintain records. Keep accurate CRM records, including call outcomes, notes, and follow-up activities.
  • Improve continuously. Participate in call reviews, role-play sessions, and ongoing coaching to strengthen your sales skills.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • Excellent communication. Clear spoken English that can be easily understood by customers in the United States.
  • Confidence. Comfortable speaking with senior business decision-makers over the phone.
  • Active listening. Able to ask insightful questions and understand customer needs.
  • Coachability. Welcomes feedback and applies it to improve performance.
  • Resilience. Maintains a positive attitude and persistence when facing rejection.
  • Curiosity. Enjoys learning about businesses and uncovering opportunities through conversation.
  • Organisation. Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately maintain CRM records and follow-up activities.
  • Fast learner. Quickly understands new products, services, and sales techniques.
  • Professionalism. Represents the company with confidence and integrity in every interaction.
  • Natural communication. Able to follow a structured sales process while sounding authentic and conversational, rather than reading mechanically from a script.
Nice to Have
  • Experience. Previous experience in marketing, cold calling, telesales, appointment setting, customer service, or B2B sales is preferred but not required. We believe communication skills, coachability, and a willingness to learn are stronger predictors of success than experience alone.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive training. Learn our products, services, and proven outbound sales process.
  • Ongoing coaching. Receive regular feedback, call reviews, and mentoring to help you succeed.
  • Career development. Build highly transferable communication, negotiation, and business development skills.
  • Remote flexibility. Work remotely with a supportive team.
  • Competitive pay. Earn USD $4–$8 per hour, depending on relevant experience, communication skills, demonstrated sales ability, and overall fit for the role. Bonuses are available for strong performance, including qualified meetings successfully booked.
  • Growth opportunities. This role has the potential to become an ongoing position for the right candidate, with opportunities for growth as you develop your skills and contribute to the team's success.

jobs.title: Business Development Executive, Flexible Packaging
jobs.excerpt: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Accredo Packaging is a vertically integrated flexible packaging manufacturer specializing in high barrier films, pouching, flexographic printing, shrink bundling, and towel and tissue overwrap. Our commitment to sustainability is real: Silver LEED certified facility powered by wind energy. We're hiring a Business Development Manager to lead our expansion into one of these key corridors.

Location: US Remote (EST or CST region)

Target Markets:Dallas-Fort Worth, TX | Atlanta, GA | Charlotte, Raleigh, NC | Ohio Major Metros

The Role

Operate as the owner of your territory with committed cross department support and an organization wide commitment to customer excellence. The focus: planning, prospecting, qualifying, and closing new business at direct end users, across regional co packers, high growth and established CPG brands, food, pharma, pet food manufacturers, and towel and tissue producers.

This role requires building and managing a balanced pipeline:

  • Immediate: Quick win opportunities with regional converters, co-packers, emerging brands, and commodity shrink bundling and overwrap business.

  • Medium term: Growing accounts that require validation cycles and operational alignment.

  • Enterprise: Large scale accounts requiring a deep understanding of the discovery process, mapping decision makers, cultivating champions, and navigating complex buying committees.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years in packaging sales, preferably flexible films and selling direct to end users.

  • Functional understanding of film structures (PE, PET, OPP, basic barrier properties) and printing.

  • Proven track record building a territory into a multi-million dollar book of business.

  • Disciplined Strategic Hunter mentality: self-directed, strategic about targeting, and energized by high volume outbound prospecting activity and building lasting relationships.

  • Strong moral compass. We value long term partnerships over quick wins. You set accurate expectations, and you keep them.

  • Team player that collaborates effectively with R&D, operations, and customer service to deliver on commitments.

  • You drive deals to decision and know when to walk away from opportunities that aren't a good fit.

  • Fortitude and perseverance with a good attitude to manage long validation cycles and see complex deals through.

What We Offer

  • Best-of-Both-Worlds Culture: We are privately family-owned but corporately run. You get the agility, accessibility to leadership, and long-term decision-making of a family business, backed by the operational discipline, systems, and scale of a major corporation.

  • Vertical Integration Advantage: Sell with confidence knowing you are backed by a facility that controls the process from pellet to pouch. This means better quality control, faster answers, and a true competitive edge in the market.

  • Sustainability That Sells: A LEED Silver certified, wind-powered facility and a portfolio of recyclable films that align with the sustainability goals of major CPGs.

  • Technical & Operational Support: You own the relationship; we support the science. You will have direct access to R&D, Product Management, and a dedicated Sales Operations and Customer Service team to help you validate complex technical structures and close deals.

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

Job Description:

Support mission-critical initiatives and enable the growth of our business as an Oracle Applications Architect at GDIT. Here, you’ll become an integral part of how GDIT is able to ensure the safety and security of our nation.

MEANINGFUL WORK AND PERSONAL IMPACT

We are seeking a highly skilled Oracle Applications Architect to lead the architecture, design, implementation and optimization of Oracle Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solutions while managing the transition from legacy finance systems. This individual will play a key role in modernizing enterprise systems, coordinating legacy data archiving and decommissioning efforts, and managing complex data conversion projects into current financial systems. The ideal candidate will have a holistic understanding of Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS), ERP Cloud, and legacy financial platforms. As a senior leader, this position requires technical expertise, strategic thought leadership, and the ability to manage cross-functional teams through enterprise-wide transformation initiatives.

Enterprise ERP Architecture and Solutions

  • Design and implement Oracle EBS and Oracle ERP Cloud solutions that meet enterprise-wide requirements for scalability, performance, and reliability.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to analyze and document functional and technical requirements, ensuring alignment with enterprise goals.
  • Design integration frameworks using tools such as Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), APIs (REST/SOAP), and middleware platforms (Fusion Middleware).
  • Manage the configuration, implementation, and optimization of Oracle Financials, Procurement and Supply Chain.
  • Lead migration strategies and data integration efforts between financial systems delivering robust and optimized implementations. Research, analyze and recommend utilities or tools to support and streamline data migration across systems

Legacy System Management

  • Develop and manage processes for archiving, tracking, coordinating, and decommissioning legacy systems, ensuring compliance with enterprise and data retention standards.
  • Coordinate with technical teams to phase out legacy applications and migrate relevant capabilities and data into Oracle ERP platforms.
  • Establish governance and quality frameworks for legacy system transitions.

Data Conversion and Migration

  • Lead the planning, design, and execution of data conversion projects to migrate legacy system data into current financial and operational systems.
  • Identify data mapping, cleansing, and transformation requirements in collaboration with business stakeholders and data owners.
  • Define best practices for ensuring data quality, consistency, and integrity during migration efforts.
  • Oversee the testing, validation and reconciliation of converted data to ensure compliance with business rules and requirements.
  • Work with teams to ensure historical legacy data is archived effectively while ensuring regulatory compliance and business continuity.

Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as a subject matter expert (SME) to provide guidance on ERP systems, data conversion methodologies, legacy archiving, and compliance standards.
  • Mentor and guide teams in implementing best practices for ERP deployment and data transformation projects.
  • Partner with business analysts, functional leads, developers, and IT teams to design and deliver integrated solutions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional efforts, ensuring alignment between technical and operational teams throughout multiple project phases.

Optimization and Support

  • Monitor, review, and optimize the performance of Oracle ERP solutions, legacy systems, and data conversion pipelines.
  • Identify and implement automation opportunities to improve efficiency for data migration and legacy system archiving processes.
  • Troubleshoot system performance issues and recommend enhancements or corrections.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO SUCCEED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 15+ years of professional experience in Oracle EBS and Oracle ERP Cloud, and enterprise system architecture. In lieu of degree, 4 additional yrs of related work experience is required.
  • Strong expertise with Oracle financials, procurement, supply chain applications, including data migration methodologies and tools.
  • Hands-on experience managing large-scale data conversion or data migration projects, particularly into Oracle ERP platforms.
  • Proficient in Oracle development tools (SQL, PL/SQL), Oracle Analytics (OTBI, BI Publisher), and middleware technologies.
  • Proven track record of managing legacy system lifecycle processes, including data archiving, accessibility, and decommissioning.
  • Strong understanding of data governance, compliance standards and best practices for maintaining data integrity.
  • Exceptional project management skills, including the ability to manage competing priorities and complex multi-stakeholder projects.
  • US Person

Preferred Skills:

  • Oracle certifications (e.g., Oracle ERP Cloud Architect, ERP Financials Specialist, or Oracle Cloud Infrastructure).
  • Knowledge of financial data architecture and experience implementing solutions for legacy system transitions.
  • Familiarity with tools and platforms used for legacy system data archiving and decommissioning.
  • Experience with enterprise systems integrations (web services, APIs), specifically using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).

Key Competencies

  • Strategic thinking with the ability to align technical solutions with enterprise goals and operational priorities.
  • Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities.
  • Collaborative mindset with experience driving consensus across cross-functional team.

GDIT IS YOUR PLACE
At GDIT, the mission is our purpose, and our people are at the center of everything we do.
● Growth: AI-powered career tool that identifies career steps and learning opportunities
● Support: An internal mobility team focused on helping you achieve your career goals
● Rewards: Comprehensive benefits and wellness packages, 401K with company match, and competitive pay and paid time off
● Community: Award-winning culture of innovation and a military-friendly workplace

OWN YOUR OPPORTUNITY

Explore a career at GDIT and you’ll find endless opportunities to grow alongside colleagues who share your sense of ownership and pride in the meaningful work we do.

jobs.description:
About this role:
Our Chief HR Officer clients find themselves challenged with the pace of change within the HR function and their respective organizations as companies continue to focus on developing digital dexterity, shifting business models and evolving customer and workforce expectations. With the support of their Executive Partner, our Gartner for CHRO clients adeptly assess the changes needed within their organization, achieve their goals more quickly and with a higher assurance of success. As an Executive Partner, you will have the opportunity to learn about and deliver solutions for the most complex talent and workforce challenges facing companies across all industries.

Partnering with the member includes developing, coaching and/or critiquing overarching HR and talent strategies; helping to develop and/or transform their HR teams/organizations, assisting/advising with the development and execution of critical initiatives such as workforce planning and development, employee experience, enterprise change management, and diversity and inclusion. Gartner for CHRO Executive Partners serve as accountability partners through delivery of research insights and personal experiences/expertise on key initiatives, priorities, and strategies.

What You’ll Do:

  • Provide executive advisory services to approximately 20 CHRO members who work across all industries and business models.
  • Work as a collaborative Gartner team member serving Gartner for CHRO members in conjunction with Team Client Managers and Account Executives
  • Participate in all phases of the member lifecycle: pre-sale, on-boarding, relationship management, delivery, review and renewal.
  • Responsible for member retention and for contributing toward growth in the region through direct support of Gartner Sales in prospect cultivation, account plan development and value demonstration activities.
  • Host and /or participate in periodic member activities, including strategy workshops, roundtables and webinars.
  • Define and deliver innovative solutions by assessing member needs and developing a customized value plan in accordance with overall Executive Program strategy and product deliverables.
  • Facilitate member interaction and peer collaboration through the Gartner for CHRO member community portal and assisted member connections.

What You’ll Need:

  • An undergraduate degree or Masters is preferred with 5+ years of experience working as a CHRO; 15+ years of experience in HR.
  • An in-depth understanding of the HR function and the role of the CHRO (including leadership, operations management, strategy and trends, use of metrics, etc.)
  • In depth understanding of the business value of HR and the alignment of business and HR strategies.
  • The Executive Partner will be an accomplished CHRO, working with the C-suite, the Board of Directors and a host of stakeholders with a broad base of expertise who has operated at a senior leadership level and driven change at all levels.
  • Gartner/(CEB) client experience preferred
  • Consulting background a plus
  • Experience consulting into the federal government on human capital issues is a plus

Who You Are:

  • Critical thinker and problem solver demonstrating the ability to assess our Member’s situations and provide actionable, outcome-based business/technical advice as well as the ability to leverage appropriate resources to help Members achieve results.
  • Excellent communication and relationship management skills, including experience working with C-level executives.
  • Ability to build strategic internal partnerships with key roles across the organization and positively impact change
  • This role is a Client-facing position that requires a high level of Executive presence and ability to quickly build trust and deliver value.
  • Demonstrate superior verbal and written communication skills as well as strong facilitation and presentation skills.

THIS IS A REMOTE POSITION THAT CAN BE LOCATED ANYWHERE IN THE UNITED STATES.

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Gartner believes in fair and equitable pay. A reasonable estimate of the base salary range for this role is 188,000 USD - 225,000 USD. Please note that actual salaries may vary within the range, or be above or below the range, based on factors including, but not limited to, education, training, experience, professional achievement, business need, and location. In addition to base salary, employees will participate in either an annual bonus plan based on company and individual performance, or a role-based, uncapped sales incentive plan. Our talent acquisition team will provide the specific opportunity on our bonus or incentive programs to eligible candidates. We also offer market leading benefit programs including generous PTO, a 401k match up to $7,200 per year, the opportunity to purchase company stock at a discount, and more.

NOCD is an award-winning digital health company focused on identifying people with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and managing them using evidence-based treatment. Although OCD affects over 181 million people globally, is ranked by the W.H.O. as a top 10 most disabling condition, and costs 3X more to treat than depression, over 90% of the OCD population isn’t able to access effective care due to stigma and misdiagnosis. As a result, OCD patients often go untreated and suffer in silence, which is why it’s nicknamed "the secret illness.”

NOCD is solving this global problem by identifying OCD patients online and managing them using our evidence-based OCD treatment platform. Inside NOCD, members can access a licensed mental health professional with specialty training in OCD who can offer online diagnostic interviews, video-based teletherapy sessions, and message-based support. In between each session, members can access moderated support communities and tech-enabled therapeutic tools to ensure they have constant support whenever their provider isn’t around. In an integrated model using our app, researchers at Columbia Medical Center found it to be effective in reducing symptoms of OCD.

Today, NOCD manages the largest community of OCD patients in the world. We’re financially supported by 7wire Ventures, a leading healthcare-focused venture capital firm in the United States. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.
