jobs.description:
Who You Are:

You are a systems-savvy financial leader with experience across planning, forecasting, and performance reporting and analysis, and a track record of turning financial data into recommendations that move the business forward. You believe FP&A exists to help the business improve its financial performance, not just report on it. You are naturally curious and love to dig into the data to understand what’s driving the business. You balance a deep understanding of the details with a clear vision of the bigger picture. You thrive in fast-paced settings, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution and process-building. You’re passionate about translating financial data into actionable insights and eager to make an impact in a dynamic, growing company.

The Task At Hand:

As Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis, you will own core planning and forecasting cycles, including annual budgeting, monthly and quarterly reforecasts, and risk and opportunity tracking. You will be the connective tissue between corporate FP&A, Operations Finance, and Commercial Finance, building and running the models and project-managing the calendar. You will translate results into management reporting, variance bridges, and margin and mix analysis that drive action, not just visibility. You will also help modernize how the team works by building automated workflows, defining consistent KPIs and model logic, and tightening the process calendar as OFarm scales as a public company.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Run monthly and quarterly P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow forecasts, validating forecast assumptions and driving accountability across business partners and cost center owners.
  • Deliver management reporting that gives leadership a timely, accurate, headline view of how the business is performing against the metrics that matter, using financial storytelling to make the numbers clear and compelling.
  • Lead variance analysis that isolates the operational drivers behind results, separating volume, mix, timing, and rate impacts to explain what moved and why.
  • Conduct margin and mix analysis to surface what’s driving Gross Profit and EBITDA performance, and where the business has room to improve.
  • Track risks and opportunities across the business, running scenario analysis to quantify exposure and upside.
  • Track initiatives and EBITDA levers that leadership can act on to proactively manage financial performance.
  • Drive the annual planning process, including maintaining & improving the forecast model in Pigment, and setting the planning templates, assumptions and drivers that anchor the process.
  • Own KPI definitions and consistent reporting for Executive Business Reviews.
  • Steer the FP&A process calendar, setting and enforcing deadlines across planning and forecasting cycles.
  • Design and build automated workflows, including with tools like Claude Cowork, that reduce manual work and improve the speed and accuracy of financial reporting and analysis.
  • Bring business and financial context to the BI/Analytics, IT Development, and EPM development teams, ensuring what gets built serves how the business plans & reports.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Accounting, Operations Finance, Commercial Finance, and BI/Analytics to ensure data integrity and alignment across systems.

In This Role, You’ll Bring With You:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field
  • 4+ years of progressive FP&A experience, including annual budgeting, forecasting, and performance reporting & analysis.
  • Strong systems thinking. Able to design scalable models and workflows in Pigment and beyond. Advanced proficiency in Excel is assumed, and knowing when a spreadsheet is the wrong tool.
  • Uses AI tools (e.g. Claude CoWork) as a working partner to build repeatable workflows, and speed up reporting & analysis.
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with a proven ability to translate data into a clear point of view.
  • Hands-on experience with an EPM/FP&A platform. Pigment experience a plus.
  • CPG industry experience a plus.
  • Solid knowledge of Microsoft Suite, Outlook, Slack, and other professional platforms.
  • Up to 10% travel required: Although this role is a remote work-from-home position, we “Farmers” do meet as a company and/or as a department a few times a year. Anticipate possible travel up to a few times each quarter.
  • Genuine passion for improving childhood nutrition for a healthier and happier planet.
  • Desire to contribute to a dynamic high-growth, purpose-driven work environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguity, deeply understand business needs, develop a cohesive strategy and make decisions requiring a high level of judgment.
  • Previous exposure to cross-functional work between Sustainability and Finance preferred.
  • Must reside in the United States to be considered for this position.
  • Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Compensation:

  • Full-Time, Salaried, Exempt
  • The anticipated salary range for this position is $120,000.00 to $150,000.00. The actual salary offer will carefully consider a few factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Certain positions are eligible for additional forms of compensation such as bonuses, stipends, equity, and role-specific perks.

Additional:

  • Remote-first work environment
  • Annual Bonus
  • 401(k) program + 4% company match after three months
  • New Hire Remote Life Stipend + annual Nourish and Nurture Allowance
  • Monthly Cell and Internet Stipend
  • Quarterly Farm-to-Fridge home deliveries and Employee Discounts
  • New Parents: Up to 18 weeks of paid Parental Leave, Baby Steps Back To Work, 3 months’ supply of Once Upon A Farm products, and breast milk shipping service and support for those who travel after birth for the duration of your breastfeeding journey
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off
  • Paid Volunteer Time
  • Paid Time Off to fulfill civic responsibilities including jury duty and voting in local, state, and national elections
  • Medical Insurance for the employee covered at 100% on select plans with additional plan options at a reduced cost to the employee
  • Vision and Dental Insurance covered at 100% for the employee and dependents
  • Life insurance
  • Flexible spending account (Medical & Dependent Care) and Health savings accounts for applicable plans
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • All other benefits, leaves, and insurance as required by law, based on your specific residence
  • And so much more!

Who We Are

Our Purpose: Drive systemic improvement in childhood nutrition for a healthier, happier, and more equitable world.

Our Business: At Once Upon a Farm, a better story starts here. We're on a greater mission in providing organic, crave-worthy, snacks and meals for children of all ages. Our recipes are crafted with only the best organic ingredients – whole fruits and veggies, cold-pressed (our pouches), or freshly frozen (our meals) to perfection– to support your growing kids at every stage. Each of our organic, non-GMO, non-dairy recipes contains no added sugar and are free from artificial flavors, colors, and preservatives – just simple, real, nutritious snacks your entire family will love.

We support and champion farmers who supply the highest-quality organic ingredients for our foods. We will always fight for and support efforts to drive positive social change and food justice for the benefit of parents, kids, and families. Lastly, we foster an entrepreneurial and collaborative culture that values humility, honesty, passion, positive social impact, and fun.

Our Team: We’re all fully remote, which makes us a highly collaborative, dynamic, and supportive bunch. You’ll help Pax8 build secure, reliable, and scalable access foundations for our people, partners, and internal teams. Your work will directly support business continuity, improve how teams collaborate across regions, and help modernise how identity and access are managed across the organisation.

This role gives you the chance to leave a real legacy: better documentation, stronger automation, cleaner access controls, smarter processes, and technology foundations that make it easier for Pax8 to scale securely.

At Pax8, we care deeply about building genuine, trust based relationships — starting with how we hire.

There's extensive room for a talented individual to grow at pace — whether that's advancing quickly in this role or exploring one of the many opportunities across our global organisation. About us:

Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

👥 Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThe AI Transformation Office at Abnormal owns how the company redesigns work around AI: mapping every business function for AI opportunity, running structured workstreams across Sales, CS, Support, Marketing, Finance, HR, Legal, and Engineering, and standing up the operating model that ties stakeholders, prioritization, and delivery together.
jobs.description:
About the Role

The AI Transformation Office at Abnormal owns how the company redesigns work around AI: mapping every business function for AI opportunity, running structured workstreams across Sales, CS, Support, Marketing, Finance, HR, Legal, and Engineering, and standing up the operating model that ties stakeholders, prioritization, and delivery together.

The Transformation Strategy Manager is the day-to-day operator inside that office. You are the connective tissue between the vision for AI-redesigned processes and the AI PMs, AI engineers, and business leaders who build and adopt them. You will translate ambiguous transformation bets into concrete requirements, run the cross-functional cadence to ship them, and own the analytics that prove whether they worked.

This role sits inside the People and Transformation org reporting to the Director of AI Transformation in the Chief Transformation Officer’s organization (with a dotted line into the People team). The lens is both functional (what gets built) and future-of-work (how Abnormal operates differently as a result).

What You Will Do

  • Be the day-to-day lead translating transformation vision into shippable requirements for AI PMs and engineers, then driving cross-functional execution to ship
  • Build and maintain the enterprise capability map: the system of record for who owns what, how it's done today, and where AI fits
  • Run the transformation intake, prioritization, and operating cadence that keeps the highest-value initiatives sequenced, resourced, and moving across functions
  • Define solution paths for each prioritized transformation, including what humans do, what AI does, what systems do, and the rationale behind the call
  • Own the measurement layer for transformation: ROI analysis, business value assessment, metric trees, instrumentation, and the analytics surface the executive team uses to assess progress
  • Drive role redesign, change management, and adoption with People COEs and functional leaders so transformations actually land in how people work
  • Lead company-wide AI initiatives end-to-end, from problem framing through rollout, that drive step-change improvements crossing three or more functions

AI Forward Hiring

This role only exists because AI is changing how work gets done at Abnormal. You should be a daily power user of frontier AI tools, comfortable building your own light-weight prototypes (Cowork skills, agents, scripts, or no-code stacks) to solve your own workflow problems, and able to talk concretely about projects where you have already redesigned how something works using AI. The case study and the presentation are explicitly designed to test this. Show us what you have built, not what you have read about.

Must Haves

jobs.description:
Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment.

Join our team and make a difference in patient care.

About the Role

As our Engagement Program Lead, you'll own how Parachute comes together. You'll run the logistics and execution behind our employee programs including company offsite, our department and team gatherings, the moments where a remote-first company creates in-person collaboration to accelerate working relationships and shared learnings. You'll also keep our People & Culture programs running day to day, so they land on time and feel considered.

We're roughly 320 people and growing fast, which makes the scale of this work real: our annual company offsite now brings the whole company together, and department gatherings are multiplying faster than any one person can plan them. A big part of your first year is standing up Offsite-in-a-Box: a set of vetted vendors, templates, and budget tools that lets any department lead plan a great gathering without starting from scratch. This role sits at the center of two things we care about: making in-person time count, and making it easy for teams to create it themselves.

About the Team

People & Culture at Parachute is a small, senior team with a growing bench behind it. One side of the function owns how we organize, how we hire and pay, and how the function runs day to day. The other side owns what happens after someone joins: engagement and organizational insight, leadership and manager capability, and the moments that bring a remote-first company together.

You sit on the Employee Experience & Development side, reporting to the VP who owns the strategy and design of these programs.

The People & Culture team is growing with expanded programming and responsibilities, which means the systems you build become how we operate — and there is room to grow with the function.

Key Responsibilities

Company events and offsites

  • Company offsite: Own end-to-end logistics for our annual company offsite including venue and vendor sourcing, contracts, travel and rooming, run-of-show, on-site execution, and post-event reconciliation
  • Department gatherings: Support department leads planning their own offsites with sourcing, budget guidance, and a sounding board on agenda and logistics
  • Spend discipline: Track spend in real time against event budgets and reconcile with Finance after every event
  • Contract and vendor governance: Route vendor agreements above our signature threshold through Legal, and hold every vendor to W-9, certificate of insurance, and indemnification requirements before signature. No employee or confidential company data goes into event vendor tools.
  • Duty of care: Own traveler safety, emergency protocols, and accessibility requirements for company-sponsored travel and on-site events.

Offsite-in-a-Box

  • Build the toolkit: Own the intake form, planning templates, vetted vendor agreements, and budget calculator that let department leads run their own gatherings, maintained as a documented, current library you are the named steward of — structured so it can serve as context for our AI tooling, not just a shared drive folder
  • Onboard planners: Bring planners into the process and collect the post-event one-pager from each gathering
  • Iterate: Refine the toolkit each quarter based on what planners tell you is missing or getting in the way
  • Automate the coordination: Use AI tooling to take coordination time out of the process: intake triage, vendor comparison, first-draft budget reconciliation, and post-event synthesis. The tenth department gathering should take materially less of your time than the first.

Program administration

  • Approvals: Run the budget approval workflow for gatherings that fit within policy, escalating only the exceptions
  • Program calendar: Coordinate logistics, communications, and scheduling for company-wide People & Culture initiatives (e.g., engagement survey launches, manager program scheduling, and recognition fulfillment)
  • Recognition: Own recognition and swag fulfillment end to end, including vendor management for our swag store. You'll partner closely with our Celebrations & Community lead on the recognition and celebrations calendar: program design and criteria sit with that lead and the VP, while execution, logistics, and vendor relationships sit with you.
  • Scale: Build and refine processes that hold up as the company grows

Inclusion & Belonging Council

  • Turn ideas into events: Partner with our Inclusion & Belonging Council to translate what they want to do into a real calendar, a real budget, and bring events to life
  • Remove the friction: Handle logistics, vendors, communications, and scheduling so Council members can spend their energy on content and community rather than coordination
  • Reach everyone: Make sure programming works for Parachuters regardless of where they sit geographically track participation for hub versus non-hub Parachuters so the gap stays visible and closing
  • Close the loop: Track participation and feedback, and bring it back to the Council so the calendar gets better each cycle

Measurement

  • Track what matters: Attendance, utilization, cost per attendee, and post-event feedback across the program, split hub versus non-hub
  • Quarterly read: Turn that into a simple quarterly summary that tells us what is working and what to change
  • Tie programs to engagement: Evaluate gatherings against movement in the connectivity and belonging sub-scores of our engagement survey, not attendance alone. Cost per attendee only means something next to the engagement lift it bought.

Requirements

  • 4–6 years in event program management, employee experience, or a related operations role
  • You have owned a multi-day offsite or large company event end to end, for 300+ people, including the budget
  • Vendor confidence. Comfortable sourcing vendors, negotiating a contract, and holding a vendor to what they committed to
  • Real budget ownership. Tracking spend as it happens and reconciling cleanly with Finance
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and deadlines simultaneously
  • Clear written and verbal communication; comfortable updating stakeholders at different levels
  • Judgment with confidential information — you will sit close to sensitive People & Culture work
  • AI fluency. Daily, active use of AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Notion AI) — and evidence you have used them to take real work off your own plate, not just familiarity with them
  • Proficiency in project management tools and software (e.g., Asana, Jira, Notion, Google Workspace)
  • Desire to work in a startup environment with a proactive and hungry mindset, and able to pivot quickly based on company needs
  • Willingness to travel (approx. 10-20% travel) for on-site execution of annual offsites, regional team gatherings and general venue sourcing.

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting a remote-first or distributed workforce
  • Experience supporting an employee resource group, culture council, or other employee-led group
  • Familiarity with offsite planning platforms or vendor marketplaces
  • Healthcare or health tech experience

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: Comprehensive plans with options for low-to-no-cost premiums
  • Employer HSA Contribution: Company-funded contributions to your Health Savings Account
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan
  • Equity Incentive Plan
  • Annual Company-Wide Bonus: Opportunity for up to 15% bonus based on company performance
  • Remote-First Culture: We are remote-first with a dedicated NYC office and reimbursement options for co-working spaces
  • Flexible Vacation Policy
  • Summer Fridays: 5 additional Fridays off during the summer (separate from PTO)
  • Home Office and Wellness Stipend
  • Monthly Internet Stipend
  • Annual Learning and Development Stipend

Base Salary Band (based on experience and level)

$85,000-$110,000

Atuação remota e contratação CLT Full.

  • Projetar arquiteturas lógicas e físicas para agentes cognitivos, conversacionais, autônomos e multiagentes utilizando Google ADK e Vertex AI Agent Engine;

  • Projetar e liderar a construção de conectores utilizando o protocolo Model Context Protocol (MCP), integrando ferramentas como GitLab, Kanbanize e Dataplex;
  • Garantir desacoplamento e alta resiliência por meio de arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando Google Cloud Pub/Sub;
  • Implementar controles Human-in-the-Loop para validação obrigatória de ações críticas;
  • Assegurar explicabilidade, governança e conformidade com políticas internas de IA;
  • Definir e gerenciar avaliações e testes de regressão com ferramentas como DeepEvals, garantindo qualidade e acurácia antes de deploys;
  • Otimizar custos de inferência de IA por meio de estratégias de cache, tuning de prompts e uso eficiente de recursos;
  • Implementar monitoramento ponta a ponta com logs estruturados, Dynatrace e telemetria integrada.

Requisitos Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida com Python 3.13+, gerenciador de pacotes uv e Google ADK (versões 2.4.x e 1.24.1);
  • Desenvolvimento de soluções code-first para IA generativa;
  • Conhecimento em Vertex AI (Agent Builder, Agent Engine, Reasoning Engine, Model Registry e Model Monitoring);
  • Experiência com modelos Gemini Pro e Flash;
  • Conhecimento avançado em RAG, embeddings, chunking, metadados e Vertex AI Vector Search;
  • Experiência com Cloud Storage (GCS), Cloud SQL (PostgreSQL e MySQL), Firestore e MongoDB Atlas;
  • Conhecimento em provisionamento de ambientes através de Terraform;
  • Experiência com construção e manutenção de pipelines GitLab CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em execução de aplicações em Cloud Run e GKE;
  • Experiência com logging estruturado em JSON com correlation_id;
  • Conhecimento em monitoramento com Dynatrace e biblioteca csf-py-dynatrace-lib;
  • Experiência com VPC Service Controls, Secret Manager e Service Accounts seguindo o princípio do menor privilégio;
  • Conhecimento em LGPD e regulamentações do BACEN aplicadas ao uso de IA no setor financeiro.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência na criação e publicação de Agent Skills utilizando agentskills.io e Google Cloud Skill Registry;
  • Certificações Google Cloud (Professional Cloud Architect, Data Engineer ou Machine Learning);
  • Vivência com ferramentas de orquestração como N8N;
  • Experiência com Data Science utilizando Vertex AI;
  • Conhecimento avançado em soluções de IA na Google Cloud Platform.

Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

  • Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja colaborativa em suas atribuições;
  • Tenha coragem para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;

CHIEF OF STAFF

Independent Contractor | Remote | Minimum 20 Hours/Week

This is an independent contractor (1099) position. VaVa contractors are responsible for managing their own taxes, benefits, and business expenses.

VaVa Virtual Assistants is a remote company based out of Atlanta, Georgia, built on the belief that businesses thrive when they have the right support behind them. We connect clients across industries like nonprofit, legal, coaching, and finance with skilled virtual professionals who bring genuine expertise to the work. Our team may be distributed, but the culture is deeply connected through daily conversation, project collaboration, and regular all-company virtual gatherings.

We are looking for a seasoned Chief of Staff who can operate as a true strategic partner to the leaders we serve. This role requires someone capable of thinking at the level of the founder or executive, filtering what deserves their attention, and translating vision into organizational action. Clients at this stage have operational support in place; what they need is a trusted advisor who can hold the weight of strategic decision-making alongside them.

Beyond your client work, you will be part of a contractor community that genuinely invests in one another's success. Regular calls with clients and fellow contractors keep you connected to the broader VaVa team, and every interaction is an opportunity to reflect our mission, vision, and values.

Please review the requirements and qualifications below carefully, as they reflect what it truly takes to succeed in this role. We appreciate your interest in joining the team.

EXPECTATIONS

Represent VaVa Virtual Assistants in a Positive and Professional Manner

  • Operate at a level of professionalism that reflects the trust placed in you by both VaVa and the executives you support
  • Serve as a model for VaVa's values within your client relationships, particularly in high-stakes or sensitive communications
  • Strengthen VaVa's contractor community by bringing a senior leadership perspective to shared spaces and conversations

Take Ownership of Client Satisfaction

  • Hold ultimate accountability for the health of the client relationship, including how well the engagement is serving their evolving strategic needs
  • Develop deep enough context about the client's priorities and pressures to anticipate what they need before they ask
  • Navigate complex or sensitive challenges with sound judgment, protecting both the quality of service and the integrity of the relationship
  • Monitor engagement scope continuously and initiate proactive conversations with clients when their needs have outgrown or shifted from the current structure

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a trusted strategic partner to the founder or executive, thinking alongside them on decisions, priorities, and organizational direction
  • Filter and manage what reaches the executive's attention, distinguishing between what requires their judgment and what can be handled or delegated
  • Translate the executive's vision and priorities into clear direction for their team, ensuring organizational alignment without requiring the founder to repeat themselves
  • Prepare the executive for high-stakes meetings, presentations, board conversations, and external engagements, including briefings, talking points, and background research
  • Oversee and synthesize reporting from across the business so the executive has an accurate, real-time picture of operations, team performance, and progress toward goals
  • Act as a senior liaison between the executive and internal teams, external stakeholders, partners, and clients, representing their interests with accuracy and discretion
  • Identify strategic gaps, emerging risks, or organizational misalignments and bring them to the executive with context and a recommended path forward
  • Support organizational planning, including quarterly priorities, team structure decisions, and resource allocation conversations
  • Draft and edit high-level communications on behalf of the executive, including board memos, partner correspondence, and internal leadership updates
  • Manage sensitive information spanning personnel, financials, legal matters, and strategic plans with an unwavering commitment to confidentiality
  • Lead or support special projects that require senior-level coordination and fall outside the scope of the existing operational team
  • Maintain awareness of the executive's bandwidth and proactively restructure their commitments when the load becomes unsustainable
  • Collaborate with an OBM or operational team where one exists, ensuring strategic priorities are translating into operational execution
  • Continuously evaluate whether the current engagement structure is serving the executive's evolving needs and initiate conversations to adjust when it is not

GENERAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • Must reside and be authorized to work in the United States
  • At least 7 years of demonstrated experience in a senior operational, strategic, or executive-level support role
  • At least 3 years of experience working full-time in a virtual or remote capacity
  • Available at least 20 hours per week to support high-touch (daily), deliverable-focused clients

TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS

Must Have

  • Proficiency in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, including the ability to create executive-level presentations, briefing documents, and reporting materials
  • Experienced use of Slack and Zoom in a senior coordination and leadership communication capacity
  • Ability to quickly orient within any CRM or project management tool a client is using, extract relevant data, and work fluently within existing systems without requiring onboarding support
  • Experience managing large-scale travel and event logistics as the project lead, including coordinating across multiple vendors, venues, and stakeholders within a single engagement
  • Comfort with strategic planning and visual thinking tools such as Notion, Lucidchart, Loom, or equivalent platforms used to align teams and communicate organizational priorities
  • General AI literacy with the ability to apply AI tools in ways that improve executive output, communication, and decision-making support

Preferred

  • Familiarity with automation tools such as Zapier or equivalent, sufficient to evaluate whether a workflow exists and direct its implementation even if not personally building it
  • Experience working within or alongside financial planning, reporting, or budgeting tools at an organizational level
  • Exposure to board-level or investor-facing documentation, communications, or meeting preparation

EDUCATION

A degree is not required, though candidates at this level often bring one. What matters far more is a demonstrated history of operating in senior-level roles with measurable strategic impact. Advanced or specialized certifications, such as those in executive leadership, organizational management, strategic planning, or a relevant industry credential, are viewed favorably and signal the kind of continued investment in professional development this role expects.

Asset Living is a third-party management firm with a proven partner in fostering thriving communities nationwide. Founded in 1986, Asset Living has decades of experience delivering exceptional value to our partners. Since the beginning, our undeniable passion has driven our organic growth from a small property management firm to one of the most trusted allies in real estate. Asset Living's growing portfolio includes a multitude of properties across the country that span the multifamily, single-family home rentals, affordable housing, build-to-rent, active adult, and student housing divisions.  

Asset Living is a fast-growing company made up of talented individuals from diverse backgrounds that differentiate us and help us drive innovation and results for our clients and communities across the US. At Asset Living, we wholeheartedly believe 'Together We Lead, Together We Succeed. We empower each other to lead by example, collaborate, and evolve – inspired by our belief that we can continually improve as individuals and as an organization. Together, we create an environment where every voice is heard, every idea is valued, and every individual experiences opportunities to grow as our company grows. When you join Asset Living, you become part of a dynamic team that thrives on unity, unique talents, and a universal culture of winning.   

Recognized as one of the nation's Best and Brightest Places to Work and ranked in the NMHC top 50 professionals, join Asset Living because of its reputation as the most trusted partner in real estate, workplace culture, and growth opportunities. Asset Living is a member of The Institute of Real Estate Management (IREM) and is recognized as an Accredited Management Organization (AMO). Together, we lead the way, and together, we achieve excellence in all that we do. Join a workplace where success is a collective journey and leadership is a shared responsibility.  

Temporary Property Recruiter

The Recruiter is responsible for creating, implementing & delivering a customer-centric experience thru recruiting strategies when leading interactions with external and internal clients by consistently exceeding expectations while effectively meeting hiring demands in the recruitment of caliber talent for Asset Living and our clients. This individual will be responsible for identifying new and valuable sources for qualified candidates, filling open positions with those candidates, and identifying and developing a pool of candidates for future opportunities. Must be able to cultivate strong relationships with Hiring Managers and the Corporate Team to understand client requirements for current and potentially open positions fully.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary recruiting support for assigned hiring managers/division
  • Coach hiring managers on recruiting best practices, interview techniques, candidate evaluation, and hiring process expectations.
  • Provide recommendations for difficult-to-fill positions through market insights and sourcing strategies.

  • Deliver a high-quality candidate experience in partnership with our hiring teams through proactive communication and timely follow-up.
  • Partner with hiring managers to provide a consistent and positive interview experience.
  • Support internal mobility initiatives by assisting current employees exploring new career opportunities within the organization.
  • Maintain accurate candidate records and recruiting activity within the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
  • Ensure job postings, offer letters, and recruiting documentation are completed accurately and within established service level expectations.
  • Monitor recruiting metrics including pipeline activity, time-to-fill, and candidate conversion rates.
  • Prepare and communicate regular recruiting updates and open position reports to operations leaders.
  • Build diverse talent pipelines through traditional and non-traditional sourcing methods.
  • Utilize market intelligence to proactively identify talent trends and hiring challenges.
  • Partner with Recruiting Operations and Marketing to maximize recruiting campaigns, hiring events, and employer branding initiatives.

jobs.description:
Cold Email Outreach Specialist (Outbound Email & Lead Generation) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Location: Middle East Preferred
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Cold Email Outreach Specialist to generate qualified sales opportunities through strategic outbound email campaigns.

This is a hands-on, performance-driven role where you’ll own the entire cold email process—from building targeted prospect lists and writing personalized outreach to managing deliverability, optimizing campaigns, and qualifying inbound responses.

Success in this role comes from combining strong copywriting, technical deliverability knowledge, and a data-driven approach to consistently generate qualified pipeline for the sales team.

If you’re passionate about outbound prospecting, enjoy experimenting with messaging, and understand what it takes to keep campaigns landing in inboxes—not spam folders—this role is for you.

What You’ll Own

Prospect Research & List Building

  • Build highly targeted prospect lists using:
    • Apollo
    • ZoomInfo
    • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
    • Crunchbase
    • Similar prospecting platforms
  • Segment prospects by:
    • Industry
    • Company size
    • Job title
    • Geography
    • Ideal Customer Profile (ICP)
  • Verify and clean contact data using:
    • NeverBounce
    • ZeroBounce
    • Clearout
  • Maintain organized prospect databases and outreach lists.

Cold Email Campaign Management

  • Write personalized cold email copy, subject lines, and calls-to-action.
  • Build and launch multi-step outbound sequences (4–8 touchpoints).
  • Personalize messaging using company and prospect research.
  • Monitor campaign performance daily.
  • Continuously optimize campaigns based on engagement and reply metrics.

Deliverability & Inbox Management

  • Manage inbox reputation using platforms such as:
    • Instantly
    • Lemlist
    • Smartlead
    • Mailwarm
  • Monitor:
    • Bounce rates
    • Spam scores
    • Sender reputation
    • Inbox health
  • Rotate sending domains and inboxes to maximize deliverability.
  • Identify and resolve deliverability issues before campaign performance declines.

Campaign Optimization & Reporting

  • Conduct A/B testing on:
    • Subject lines
    • Messaging
    • CTAs
    • Send times
  • Track key metrics including:
    • Open rates
    • Positive reply rates
    • Bounce rates
    • Conversion rates
  • Prepare campaign performance reports and recommend improvements.
  • Document testing results and optimization history.

Lead Qualification & CRM Management

  • Review campaign replies and categorize responses accurately.
  • Identify qualified prospects and route them to the sales team.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records using:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • Zoho CRM
    • Similar CRM platforms
  • Ensure outreach data remains organized and up to date.

Compliance & Best Practices

  • Ensure campaigns comply with:
    • CAN-SPAM
    • GDPR
    • CCPA
  • Maintain suppression and unsubscribe lists.
  • Follow outbound email best practices to protect sender reputation.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Excellent persuasive and concise writing skills.
  • Strong analytical mindset with a focus on performance improvement.
  • Comfortable using outbound automation and deliverability tools.
  • Organized, proactive, and highly execution-focused.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Continuously tests, learns, and optimizes campaign performance.

Required Experience & Skills

Experience

  • 1–2+ years of experience in:
    • Cold Email Outreach
    • Outbound Lead Generation
    • Sales Development (SDR)
    • Outbound Marketing

Technical Skills

  • Hands-on experience with:
    • Apollo
    • Instantly
    • Lemlist
    • Smartlead
    • Woodpecker
    • Similar outreach platforms
  • Experience writing cold email campaigns.
  • Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Excellent written English communication.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience managing large-scale email deliverability.
  • Understanding of:
    • DNS
    • SPF
    • DKIM
    • DMARC
  • Experience supporting B2B SaaS, agencies, or service businesses.
  • Experience collaborating with SDRs or Account Executives.
  • Familiarity with outbound automation workflows and CRM integrations.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

  • Build and refine prospect lists.
  • Launch and monitor outbound email campaigns.
  • Review inbox health and deliverability metrics.
  • Optimize messaging, targeting, and campaign performance.
  • Qualify interested prospects and hand them off to sales.
  • Update CRM records and maintain campaign documentation.

In short: You own outbound email execution—from research and personalization to optimization and lead qualification—ensuring a consistent flow of qualified opportunities into the sales pipeline.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • High email open rates.
  • Positive reply and conversation rates.
  • Low bounce rates and strong inbox health.
  • Consistent campaign execution and optimization.
  • Accurate CRM documentation.
  • Growth in qualified outbound pipeline.

Why Join Us?

  • Own the complete outbound email process from strategy to execution.
  • Work with modern sales engagement and automation tools.
  • Directly influence pipeline growth and revenue generation.
  • Performance-driven environment with measurable impact.
  • Opportunities to grow into:
    • Senior Outbound Specialist
    • Sales Development Team Lead
    • Outbound Growth Manager
    • Revenue Operations

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video (3–5 minutes)
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Practical Assessment (Cold Email Sequence Exercise)
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video is the next step that completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient for you.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. This helps the hiring team evaluate your communication style early, making future interviews more meaningful while reducing unnecessary interview rounds.

Don’t overthink it—you can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it. Only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation after submitting your application.

Apply Now

If you’re passionate about outbound prospecting, enjoy writing high-performing cold emails, understand email deliverability, and want to help generate qualified sales opportunities through data-driven outreach, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and become a key contributor to building a predictable outbound pipeline.

  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git

  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.

You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Fusable is seeking a strategic finance leader to serve as a key business partner to our CFO and executive leadership team. This is a high visibility role with the opportunity to build-out a world-class corporate FP&A function in a PE-backed environment.

  • Enhance forecasting accuracy through improved processes, data governance, and financial systems.

SpotMe is a leading B2B event platform that helps enterprises increase the impact of their events by delivering CRM-connected, high-quality experiences across in-person, virtual, hybrid events, and webinars. With a strong focus on life sciences, SpotMe powers Onomi: an HCP engagement product that enables medical and commercial teams to run impactful congresses, symposia, advisory boards, and webinars. Together, SpotMe and Onomi turn events into a company's most effective engagement channel.

This position is the ideal role for an agency meetings project manager or event/meeting planner with experience in congress/convention or education planning and execution, and interested in technology, engagement and analytics.

You bring 2+ years of prior experience in congress engagement, KOL and stakeholder management, congress and education event project planning and execution. You know the quirks of event approval workflows across Commercial, Legal Review, not just that they exist, but how they actually slow things down and how to work them.

As a Project Manager, your role will be to lead and execute end-to-end congress, webinar, adboard and education event projects both onsite and remote.

This will involve independently building, configuring and launching our suite of live engagement apps (web, mobile, portal, video, AI) using our SpotMe Backstage Content Management System (30%).

You will be professionally managing our customers, and other senior stakeholders with clear, timely communications to enhance experience adding value across the entire project lifecycle (20%).

As you approach the live event, you will coordinate closely with stakeholders to ensure seamless execution on event day. You will be training faculty, field sales team, booth staff and agencies, and thoroughly reviewing the event apps to guarantee flawless delivery. You will ensure that onsite technology (interaction tracking with apps, microapps, iPads, badge printers) has been fully configured and tested end-to-end. (20%).

For the live event, your responsibilities may vary depending on the type of modules being used but may include ensuring speakers are fully briefed and prepared, whether they're presenting in a webinar, hosting a virtual session, or speaking onsite at a standalone or symposium. You will be responsible for all event operations running smoothly for both virtual and face to face projects (20%).

Following the event, you'll handle post-event communications, analyze event data, and deliver detailed reports, dashboards and recommendations to the customer, highlighting successes and identifying areas for future improvement (10%).

Objectives - The problems you will solve

During your 6-month ramp-up period:

In your first 3 months, you will onboard, get hands-on with our product and solutions, become familiar with our existing standard operating procedures and get introduced to our services, implementation, product and sales teams. This means you will:

  • Learn Backstage and our product by building and test driving a mobile app and webinar during your first week.
  • Building all of your existing and new events in Backstage with minimal supervision, demonstrating quality follow-up emails and no errors in all core modules of the event found during the Project Reviews.
  • Getting trained on how we deliver projects at SpotMe, develop a deep understanding of the value of our products proposition and experience it by shadowing colleagues in a full project lifecycle in month 1/2.
  • Managing at least 3 complete on-site projects end-to-end - including onsite presence for at least 2 events.

In your first 6 months, you have:

  • Become an advocate for our medical education tactics, successfully influencing faculty members to adopt them.
  • Gone global, completing an international onsite project with our Europe team or one of our Europe customers.
  • Mastered the full playbook by leading and completing a project in each of our core use cases: webinar, congress, education and advisory board.
  • Been consistently recognized by clients for delivering best-in-class contributions that elevated event execution and enhanced overall participant experience and outcomes.

At 12 months, as a SpotMe product subject matter expert, you will have grown well beyond delivery into a trusted, multi-format expert who shapes how we run programs:

  • Led an average of ~7 onsite projects per quarter (≈28 per year), or 13 remote projects per quarter, or an equivalent mix.
  • Started growing the next generation of PMs, supervising 2-5 projects per quarter alongside junior/associate team members.
  • Driven new business, by successfully concluding a meaningful upsell deal through one of your referrals and/or joining at least one business development activity with our sales team (webinar, tradeshow, speaking engagement, or RFP pitch).

This role requires frequent travel, out of hours availability and weekend work. About 20 to 40% of your time will be spent traveling onsite. Project planning typically occurs 3-9 weeks in advance, depending on project type.

What you need to be great at

  • Building strong stakeholder relationships with a service-driven mindset: you adeptly engage US and EU customers, KOLs, and medical societies by understanding their unique needs - you navigate and plan every interaction with an extreme sense of service, aligning with corporate pharma stakeholders and KOLs.
  • Influence and escalation: you understand how pharma decision-making works and confidently escalate to leadership when necessary to move projects beyond initial hurdles and bypass common delays and objections.
  • Technical dexterity: you have the ability to effectively and confidently deliver practical solutions (build and ship).
  • Balancing compliance with business needs: you can skillfully balance pharma regulatory compliance and legal review processes with business objectives, navigating and resolving potential roadblocks without compromising project momentum.
  • Product-smart: you understand not every customer request translates directly into a feature. You have the ability to generalize needs and prioritize solutions that deliver true value.

SpotMe recruits, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, parental status, or veteran status.

jobs.description:
Precision for Medicine is hiring an experienced TMF Lead/Senior TMF lead to join our team, candidates can work remotely in Serbia, Poland, Hungary, Romania or Slovakia.
The TMF Lead/Senior TMF Lead is responsible for oversight, creation, management, and delivery of the eTMF in accordance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP), E6 ICH Guidelines and other regulatory guidance documents, relevant regulations (e.g., 21 CFR Parts 312 and 314, EMA Clinical Trials Directives), and Precision Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) as appropriate. The Senior TMF Lead may take on responsibility for the complex and/or challenging studies. Additionally, the Senior TMF lead supports the development and implementation of TMF-related processes and systems.
Essential Functions of the job include but are not limited to:
· Creates and executes the study TMF Plan and project TMF Document Index. Ensures entire study team understands expectations, project-specific aspects of the TMF, and manages communication of any changes in the TMF.
· Attends and contributes to project kick-off meetings, project internal or external meetings, and ad hoc meetings as needed to ensure the project team is aware of the status of the eTMF, gaps, and escalations.
· Ensures the eTMF system is updated with the information related to countries, sites, contacts and applicable TMF document requirements.
· Engages and collaborates with the Project Manager and Functional Leads to ensure TMF documentation is submitted in a timely manner and with high quality to maintain the TMF in an inspection-ready state. Anticipates challenges to TMF compliance and identifies early signals of risk. Develops and implements plans to increase compliance and follows-up on non-compliance.
· Monitors and reports on TMF Health to internal team and sponsor. Identifies trends, risks, and overall status of the TMF.
· Serves as point of contact and Subject Matter Expert (SME) for project audits or inspections and supports in the report responses. Escalates to TMF management in cases of significant risk to Precision.
· Initiates and performs Quarterly Completeness/Compliance checks for assigned projects and ensures proper documentation.
· Identifies project team TMF training needs and provides or supports team re-education.
· Manages the close-out activities of assigned studies, including defining the timeline for final document submission, final document processing, close out of all outstanding queries, requesting the eTMF export from the vendor, transfers to the sponsor and collects the Acknowledgement of Receipt.
· Provides training and education to the Clinical Solutions functions to build knowledge and awareness of the good documentation practices and TMF on clinical trials.
· Manages projects within the Sponsor eTMF Systems and actively listens to deliver insightful solutions for challenges.
· Support process development or improvement initiatives within the Records Management department. Train and mentor junior Records Management team members for their TMF responsibilities
· Serves as a System Superuser and carrying out the activities assigned to them within tickets.
Qualifications:
Minimum Required:
  • 4-year college degree or equivalent combination of education and experience, ideally in a business, scientific or healthcare discipline.
  • At least 3 to 4 years of experience with TMF and/or eTMF with at least 1 year's + experience working as a TMF Lead.
Other Required:
  • Established experience and fluency in the Microsoft Office package of programs (Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)
  • Ability to speak English proficiently (professional level)
  • Ideally have experience using Veeva Vault to process documents
Skills:
  • Demonstrates solid interpersonal skills.
  • Demonstrates, or can be trained and retain a working knowledge of ICH-GCP, and relevant Precision SOPs and regulatory guidance.
  • Manage competing priorities effectively.
Competencies:
  • Exhibits strong self-motivation.
  • Detail-oriented and able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment.
  • Demonstrates professionalism, as evidenced by punctuality, ability to deliver on commitments, and maintain positive interactions with internal and external stakeholders
  • Communicates both verbally and in written form in an efficient and professional manner
  • Demonstrates values and a work ethic consistent with Precision Values and Company Principles
  • Identify when escalations are necessary as well as identify and execute/communicate resolution with leadership support.

jobs.title: Head of Business Development - Logos
jobs.excerpt: Logos is a movement supporting the development of the decentralised web.
jobs.description:
Logos is a movement supporting the development of the decentralised web. Logos technologies lay the foundations for a freer internet upon which communities can evolve into network states. Each protocol in the Logos stack seeks to empower its users while upholding civil liberties and fundamental freedoms.

About Logos:

Logos is building the technology and community required for a more sovereign, decentralised world.

Our technology stack spans decentralised infrastructure, communications and storage, with a focus on privacy, censorship resistance and permissionless systems. We work at the intersection of protocol development, Web3 infrastructure and ecosystem building.

We’re looking for a Head of Business Development to own and drive business development across Logos, while leading a team of two.

This isn't a traditional sales role. We're looking for someone who is deeply embedded in the Web3 infrastructure ecosystem, with a strong understanding of how decentralised networks operate and experience working with/launching privacy-focused protocols. Crucially, you'll have been through a mainnet launch and understand what it takes to build the partnerships, ecosystem and infrastructure relationships required both in the lead-up to launch and as the network scales post-mainnet.

The role:

As Head of Business Development, you will lead the development and execution of strategies to grow the Logos ecosystem. You will be responsible for establishing strategic partnerships, designing and executing growth strategies and building any relevant commercial relationships.

You'll identify where Logos technology can solve real problems, build relationships with protocols and infrastructure providers, and work closely with our technical teams to turn opportunities into integrations and long-term partnerships.

You'll also manage and develop a team of two, providing direction and prioritisation while remaining highly hands-on yourself.

A core part of the role is being able to operate credibly with technical stakeholders. You don't need to be an engineer, but you should understand the technology stack well enough to have substantive conversations with protocol teams, founders and engineering leaders without relying on someone else to translate the technology for you.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute Logos’ BD and partnership strategy, building strategic relationships ahead of mainnet and driving ecosystem growth and adoption through expanded distribution channels post-launch.
  • Identify the ecosystems, protocols, infrastructure providers and applications where Logos technology can deliver the greatest value and bring users and volume to Logos network
  • Build a focused pipeline of high-value opportunities rather than pursuing partnerships for their own sake.
  • Establish clear priorities and success metrics for BD activity, owning the performance of BD goals against budget.
  • Own opportunities from initial identification through technical evaluation, negotiation, integration and ongoing relationship management.

Build technically meaningful partnerships:

  • Develop relationships across the Web3 infrastructure ecosystem, including wallets, centralised exchanges, on/off-ramps, oracles, indexers, DeFi protocols and aggregators, multisigs and other infrastructure providers, with a particular focus on those actively engaged in the privacy ecosystem.
  • Identify opportunities for integrations, deployments, ecosystem partnerships and adoption of Logos technology.
  • Understand prospective partners’ technical architecture and identify how Logos can complement their technology stack through its privacy capabilities, while attracting privacy-focused applications and protocols to build on the Logos ecosystem.
  • Work with technical teams on both sides to move opportunities from conversation to implementation.
  • Represent Logos credibly with founders, protocol leads, ecosystem teams and technical decision-makers.

Understand the technology:

You should be comfortable discussing concepts such as:

  • L1s, L2s and modular blockchain architectures
  • P2P and decentralised networking
  • Nodes, validators and network operators
  • Consensus and distributed systems
  • Decentralised storage and messaging
  • RPC and blockchain infrastructure
  • Wallet and application infrastructure
  • Token and network incentive models
  • Testnets, mainnets and network launches
  • Privacy-preserving and censorship-resistant technologies

You don't need to write production code, but you need genuine technical curiosity and enough depth to understand what we're building, why it matters, and how it can be used by others.

Lead the team:

  • Manage, mentor and develop an existing team of two BD contributors.
  • Set priorities and ensure the team is focused on the opportunities most likely to create meaningful adoption.
  • Establish a disciplined approach to pipeline management, ownership and follow-through.
  • Support the team on complex partnerships and negotiations.
  • Create accountability without introducing unnecessary processes or bureaucracy.
  • Remain hands-on with strategically important relationships and opportunities.

Work across Logos:

  • Partner closely with protocol, engineering, product, ecosystem and communications teams.
  • Bring market and partner feedback back into the organisation to help inform product and ecosystem priorities.
  • Translate technical capabilities into clear propositions for different partners and use cases.
  • Help technical teams understand the commercial and strategic context behind potential integrations.
  • Ensure partnerships result in tangible outcomes rather than announcements alone.

Required skills:

  • Significant experience in Web3, blockchain or decentralised infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of the technical architecture of blockchain networks and Web3 infrastructure.
  • Experience in business development, ecosystem development, strategic partnerships or a closely related role.
  • Evidence of building partnerships that resulted in real integrations, adoption, users, network activity or revenue.
  • Existing relationships across the Web3 infrastructure ecosystem.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with highly technical stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the ability to distinguish strategically valuable opportunities from noise.
  • Experience managing or mentoring a small team.
  • Comfortable operating autonomously in a remote, highly technical organisation.
  • A builder mentality; you enjoy taking opportunities from an initial idea through to something that actually exists.

We'd be especially interested in people who have worked within privacy focused ecosystems in areas such as:

  • Privacy focused L1 or L2 ecosystems
  • Decentralised networking projects relating to messaging, storage and or Privacy tools and applications
  • Wallets
  • Experience in Open-source protocols is a must

Hiring process:Interview with our People Ops team
Interview with Artem (IR Lead) & Rahul (BD)

Task

Interview with Kaushal (EcoDev Team Lead)
Interview with Co-founders, Jarrad & Carl

We occasionally use cognitive tests and/or personality tests to gain insight into candidates' suitability with our org. The results provide an additional data point for us when making our hiring decisions. The steps may change along the way if we see it makes sense to adapt the interview stages, so please consider the above as a guideline.

Compensation:

The expected compensation range for this role is negotiable, dependent on how we assess your skills and experience throughout our interview process. We are happy to pay in any mix of fiat/crypto

Salary Range: $90,000 - $120,000

We’ve Got You Under Our Wing

We are the duck. We develop and empower our people, cultivate relationships, give back to our community, and celebrate every success along the way. We do it all…The Aflac Way.

Aflac, a Fortune 500 company, is an industry leader in voluntary insurance products that pay cash directly to policyholders and one of America's best-known brands. Aflac has been recognized as Fortune’s 50 Best Workplaces for Diversity and as one of World’s Most Ethical Companies by Ethisphere.com.

Our business is about being there for people in need. So, ask yourself, are you the duck? If so, there’s a home, and a flourishing career for you at Aflac.

Work Designation.Depending on your location within the continental US, this role may be hybrid or remote.

  • If you live within 50 miles of the Aflac offices located in Columbus, GA or Columbia, SC, this role will be hybrid.This means you will be expected to work in the office for at least 60% of the work week. You will work from your home (within the continental US) for the remaining portion of the work week. Details of this schedule will be discussed with your leadership.
  • If you live more than 50 miles from the Aflac offices located in Columbus, GA or Columbia, SC, this role will be remote. This means you will be expected to work from your home, within the continental US. If the role is remote, there may be occasions that you are requested to come to the office based on business need. Any requests to come to the office would be communicated with you in advance.

What does it take to be successful at Aflac?

  • Acting with Integrity
  • Communicating Effectively
  • Pursuing Self-Development
  • Serving Customers
  • Supporting Change
  • Supporting Organizational Goals
  • Working with Diverse Populations

What does it take to be successful in this role?

  • Has extensive knowledge of changes to policies, procedures, and governance tools, to ensure processes are up-to-date, reflect new policies and facilitate implementation within own work area
  • Solid Group Life/Disability underwriting knowledge
  • Understanding of Group Life and Disability products and services, affiliated systems and applicable operational policies and procedures
  • Strong math skills
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills
  • Knowledge and skills in experience rating Life, STD, LTD, Leave products and analyzing competitor experience data

Education & Experience Required

  • Bachelor's Degree In a related field
  • 4 years of financial underwriting experience with Group Life, STD, LTD and Leave products for employer groups exceeding 1,000 covered lives or 5 years of financial underwriting experience with Group Life, STD, LTD, and Leave products, including 2 years of experience for employer groups exceeding 1,000 covered lives

Or an equivalent combination of education and experience

Principal Duties & Responsibilities

  • Completes assignments of high complexity while working within delegated authority
  • Provides technical underwriting support and guidance to customers and distributors, consistently providing excellent customer service
  • Maintains distributor relationships by consistently requesting the correct evidence, consistently making the correct decision and always explaining rating decisions
  • Completes a range of queries and referrals within agreed authority limits, measuring the exposure analyzing the risk of each case to maintain underwriting standards
  • Proactively contributes to the development and improvement of technical underwriting standards, controls, practices and procedures to better meet business goals
  • Proactively contributes ideas and work for the development of new or enhanced propositions /procedures/philosophy, ensuring we charge the right premium for the associated risk
  • Proactively supports development of self and others and contributing to a positive and supportive team culture
  • Identifies training opportunities for self and others and assists with training as directed
  • Works closely with distributors and other operational areas to support the overall achievement of the business plan, demonstrating knowledge in underwriting expertise, systems, procedures and processes
  • Assists with quality reviews in order to help identify, assess and take action to mitigate risks to achievement of underwriting goals and objectives
  • Undertakes investigations and inspections of data, processes and practice to identify potential or actual compliance issues and recommend appropriate action
  • Collates and analyzes data and make recommendations to support the underwriter´s decision making process
  • Assesses and evaluates underwriting processes in order to identify areas for improvement, tracking actions and monitoring implementation to demonstrate the impact that change may have
  • Acts as lead technical resource for standard methodologies and systems knowledge to enable underwriters to deliver to customers efficiently and effectively
  • Reviews and interprets information and advises internal clients of appropriate action to fulfill procedural and regulatory requirements
  • Performs other duties as required

Total Rewards

The salary range for this job is $90,000 - $120,000. This range is specific to the job and salary offers consider a wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including, but not limited to: education, experience, licensure, certifications, geographic location, and peer compensation. The range has been created in good faith based on information known to Aflac at the time of the posting.

At Aflac, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for the role to allow for future and continued salary growth, and compensation decisions are dependent on the circumstances of each case. This salary range does not include any potential incentive pay or benefits, however, such information will be provided separately when appropriate.

In addition to the base salary, we offer an array of benefits to meet your needs including medical, dental, and vision coverage, prescription drug coverage, health care flexible spending, dependent care flexible spending, Aflac supplemental policies (Accident, Cancer, Critical Illness and Hospital Indemnity offered at no costs to employee), 401(k) plans, annual bonuses, and an opportunity to purchase company stock. On an annual basis, you’ll also be offered 11 paid holidays, up to 20 days PTO to be used for any reason, and, if eligible, state-mandated sick leave (Washington employees accrue 1-hour sick leave for every 40 hours worked) and other leaves of absence, if eligible, when needed to support your physical, financial, and emotional well-being. Aflac complies with all applicable leave laws, including, but not limited to, sick and safe leave, and adoption and parental leave, in all states and localities.

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

As Technical Sales Manager, you play a central role in securing new business by leading the technical work behind audits and requests for proposals, as well as the technical component of the client-facing pitch. You coordinate contributions across Thrive’s teams, establish a clear audit narrative, and translate complex findings into credible, commercially relevant recommendations. You partner with Business Development to ensure every presentation accurately represents Thrive’s expertise, responds to the client’s needs, and strengthens confidence in choosing Thrive.

You also drive growth within existing client partnerships through proactive internal audits with the Performance team. By examining performance, identifying untapped opportunities, and clearly demonstrating the value of Thrive’s work, you help teams protect strong partnerships and build the case for thoughtful expansion.

You own the quality and evolution of Thrive’s audit discipline, including its methods, standards, internal artifacts, and client-facing outputs. You coach contributors, coordinate stakeholders, maintain technical rigour, and ensure recommendations remain grounded in evidence and aligned with Thrive’s delivery capabilities.

Your focus of responsibilities will be:

  • Domain: Own the technical audit discipline, ensuring every assessment is scoped, evidence-based, repeatable, and translated into commercially relevant recommendations.
  • Client: Build client confidence by leading complex technical conversations, clarifying expectations, and connecting evidence-based recommendations to business goals.
  • People: Develop our audit capability through practical training, direct coaching, quality feedback, and clear standards for technical and client-facing work.
  • Company: Drive growth by supporting qualification, uncovering expansion opportunities, strengthening market credibility, and turning audit insights into service innovation.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

  • In your first 30 days, you’ll learn Thrive’s sales process, observe client pitches and conversations, and begin leading technical components of calls, as well as begin leading sales-focused audits with some support.
  • In your first 60 days, you’ll lead technical components of client pitches and conversations, and lead sales-driven Audits & RFPs.
  • In your first 90 days, you’ll own all technical components of client pitches and conversations, and lead sales-driven audits & RFPs from back end analysis through to pitch.


Qualifications

  • You’ve directly managed and optimized low-to-high complexity e-commerce and demand generation accounts, including multimillion-dollar annual media investments.
  • You’ve worked inside active advertising accounts to diagnose measurement, structure, budgeting, targeting, creative, and performance challenges alongside delivery teams.
  • You’ve led end-to-end technical audits, turning account-level evidence into prioritized recommendations, practical actions, and commercially relevant growth opportunities.
  • You’ve presented and defended technical recommendations to executive and senior marketing stakeholders during high-stakes new-business and expansion conversations.
  • You’ve coordinated sales, strategy, media, creative, and data contributors across audits and requests for proposal, owning scope, timelines, narrative, and quality.
  • You’ve strengthened internal operations through proactive audits, hands-on team support, repeatable standards, improved workflows, and contributor training.

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. The role is to deploy, integrate, and operate high-performance storage for GPU-accelerated compute and AI platforms. You will own the storage layer where Kubernetes meets bare metal — standing up NFS-based high-performance storage, wiring it into clusters via CSI, and tuning it to keep data flowing to GPU workloads at scale. Work spans hybrid, edge, and air-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack.

About the Role

We are looking for a senior systems engineer who treats storage as infrastructure to be automated, observed, and tuned — not hand-managed. The right candidate is fluent in Kubernetes storage, deeply versed in Linux storage and networking fundamentals down to the kernel and NFS-client layer, and knows how to make high-performance NAS actually perform under demanding workloads. You should reach for infrastructure-as-code and GitOps by default, be self-directed in diagnosing performance and reliability issues end to end, set operational standards for others to follow, and communicate clearly across teams. Bare-metal hardware experience is a strong plus, but deep Linux storage knowledge is essential.

Responsibilities

1. Storage Integration & Operation

  • Integrate NFS-based high-performance storage (e.g., VAST, Dell PowerScale) into Kubernetes clusters via CSI, storage classes, and persistent volumes.
  • Tune the NFS data path — mount options, nconnect/RDMA, Linux client, and network settings — for high-throughput, low-latency GPU/AI workloads.
  • Deploy and operate storage services and operators; manage capacity, quotas, snapshots, and lifecycle.

2. Linux Platform & System Integration

  • Configure and optimize Linux systems for storage workloads, including driver setup, file system layout, network tuning, and kernel parameter optimization.
  • Deliver storage integration for k0s-based Kubernetes via Cluster API (CAPI) and K0rdent management/child cluster topologies.
  • Operate storage in fully disconnected (air-gapped) environments, including local artifact/mirror connectivity (Harbor) and PKI/TLS considerations.

3. Automation & Observability

  • Automate storage provisioning and configuration with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/OpenTofu) and GitOps pipelines (ArgoCD or Flux).
  • Build monitoring, alerting, and observability for storage performance, capacity, and health.
  • Diagnose and resolve performance, reliability, and scaling issues across the storage stack.
